subject: Why Clark County and Washoe County Law Enforcement Leaders Support Adam Laxalt
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Laxalt for Senate
body:
|
---
| | **A brief message in support of Adam Laxalt from former Washoe County District Attorney Dick Gammick, former Washoe County Sheriff Chuck Allen, President of the Las Vegas Police Protective Association Steve Grammas, and former Clark County Sheriff Bill Young:**

Violent crime is surging, lethal drugs are pouring into our towns and cities, criminals are running around with a sense of impunity, and police officers are under constant assault. Folks simply don’t feel safe in their communities anymore.

The good news is that Nevadans have an opportunity to do something about it in this fall’s election for U.S. Senate. The current Senator, Catherine Cortez Masto, has turned her back on Nevada’s law enforcement community and been a rubber stamp for Democrats’ soft-on-crime policies. The other candidate, Nevada’s former Attorney General Adam Laxalt, has a proven track record of supporting the police and doing whatever is necessary to clamp down on crime.

The choice in this race is clear. We are supporting Adam Laxalt for U.S. Senate on election day and we urge you to do the same.

As Nevada’s Attorney General from 2015 through 2018, Mr. Laxalt distinguished himself in his commitment to safeguarding our communities, enforcing the rule of law, and supporting Nevada’s police officers. During his tenure, Laxalt went out of his way to ensure law enforcement entities had the resources they needed to do their jobs. He even organized the first statewide summit bringing together police, sheriffs, and peace officers to identify crime trends and develop new strategies to improve public safety. To combat the rise in opioid usage and overdoses, Laxalt arranged for every law enforcement agency in the state to have naloxone as an antidote to opioid overdoses in the line of duty. He also funded additional incinerators around the state to help get dangerous drugs like fentanyl off our streets and out of our communities.

Adam Laxalt's record speaks for itself. He is not your run-of-the-mill politician. He is a straight shooter and a results-driven leader who has shown that he will do whatever is necessary to support law enforcement and keep our communities safe.

Since taking office, Cortez Masto has been a rubber stamp for Democrats’ soft-on-crime policies and anti-police agenda. She has voted in favor of numerous radical officials, including those who have refused to prosecute drug dealers. She has called the police racist and stood idly by as radical organizations sought to defund the police and release violent criminals back onto our streets. And when a local officer was shot in the head during riots she encouraged, she didn’t say a word.

This is why Adam is endorsed by 95% of law enforcement in Nevada, including the Nevada Fraternal Order of Police and the Public Safety Alliance of Nevada (PSAN), which represents over 10,000 law Enforcement Officers throughout over 100 state and local organizations. Many police organizations switched their endorsement from Sen. Cortez Masto to Adam because of her soft-on-crime approach and her affiliation with far-left radicals who support defunding the police.

Catherine Cortez Masto let us, and the hardworking people of Nevada, down. That is why nearly all of Nevada’s police organizations are rescinding their support for her and instead endorsing Adam Laxalt in this year's election.

Mr. Laxalt is the only candidate in the race who will stand with law enforcement, push for common-sense solutions to clamp down on crime, and oppose efforts by the radical left to defund the police and undermine public safety efforts.

He deserves our support on November 8th.

Regards,

**Dick Gammick, former Washoe County District Attorney (1994-2014)

Chuck Allen, former Washoe County Sheriff (2015-2019)

Steve Grammas, 24-Year Las Vegas Metro Police Officer, President of Las Vegas Police Protective Association

Bill Young, 28-Year Las Vegas Metro Police Officer, former Clark County Sheriff (2003-2007)**

#
Derek,
I’m proud to say that yesterday, I stood on stage with President Barack Obama at our huge GOTV rallies in Pittsburgh + Philly. 🥰
We got some amazing photos from both rallies that I wanted to share with you. Some of these we haven’t posted on social media yet, so they are truly exclusive.
**[Please enjoy these photos, and then please consider making a donation of $5 to help us meet our 48-hour GOTV goal of raising $1 million. _“If someone is willing to peddle snake oil to make a buck, then he’s probably willing to sell us snake oil to get elected. You deserve better than somebody who’s just trying to make a quick buck, someone willing to say anything to get attention. You deserve somebody who knows you. You deserve somebody who’s stood side-by-side with you. Somebody who will work every day and fight for you. Somebody who’s actually from Pennsylvania.**You deserve somebody like John Fetterman.** ”_ —President Barack Obama
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221106-4?refcode=em20221106-8095&refcode2=8095_434096_FaR2UN&akid=8095%2E434096%2EFaR2UN)
I’m really just so grateful to President Obama for coming out to Pennsylvania, and for supporting me + Democrats up and down the ballot.
The stakes of this election couldn’t be higher. But after yesterday’s rallies, I know PA is fired up, and ready to go.
**[Can you join Obama in supporting our campaign by making a donation of $5 to help us meet our 48-hour GOTV goal of raising $1 million? We need all hands on deck to send Oz back to Jersey and send me to D.C. to fight for folks like you.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221106-4?amount=5&refcode=em20221106-8095&refcode2=8095_434096_FaR2UN&akid=8095%2E434096%2EFaR2UN)**

❤️ John
John Fetterman

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, I will be a much better Senator for Kentucky than Rand
Paul.

Here’s how I know: In 12 years in the Senate, he’s never passed a bill. He
also refused to debate me. And he closed all but one of his in-state
offices.

Put simply: He doesn’t care about Kentucky. But I do.

I can represent the people of Kentucky because I know what it’s like to
struggle.

Growing up, I experienced the pain of poverty firsthand and saw my mom
skip meals so that I could have enough. I’ve been homeless and have had to
ration my insulin because I couldn’t afford the medication I needed as a
Type 1 diabetic.

But with just two days remaining, I need your help. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18844?t=1001&akid=2737%2E346206%2EGstdIH ]So I have to ask:
Will you pitch in $20 or more to help me win on Tuesday and defeat Rand
Paul?

DONATE NOW →

My name is Charles Booker. I’m on a mission to defeat Rand Paul and
restore leadership to the Senate and representation for Kentucky, from the
Hood to the Holler.

Thank you,

Charles

name: Jeff Goldblum
subject: I can’t sit on the sidelines
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
#
Hi Derek, it’s Jeff Goldblum.
Over the years, you might have seen me on the big screen trying to take on major challenges — from aliens to dinosaurs. But today, I wanted to take a moment to visit with you about a challenge we’re facing right now:**Pennsylvania’s U.S. Senate race.**
I grew up around Pittsburgh, just down the Monongahela River from where John Fetterman and his family live in Braddock now, so this is personal to me.
It’s not hard to see the serious problems mounting in communities across PA and across the country. And in addition to the kitchen table issues Americans care about year after year, climate change and reproductive rights are all on the line in this election.
**So I can’t sit on the sidelines.**
John has proven himself to be an honorable leader, in Braddock as mayor and for all of PA as lieutenant governor. He’s spent his career fighting for working people — not making a profit off of them — and we need him continuing to fight for us in the U.S. Senate next year.
**It’s not often that we can face what seems like an insurmountable challenge and make a difference in real life, but this is our chance.** **[So Derek, will you join me in supporting John Fetterman’s campaign by making a donation of any amount today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221106-5?refcode=em20221106-8056&refcode2=8056_434096_HrzeQa&akid=8056%2E434096%2EHrzeQa)**
**[RUSH $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221106-5?amount=5&refcode=em20221106-8056&refcode2=8056_434096_HrzeQa&akid=8056%2E434096%2EHrzeQa)**
Our leaders now determine what kind of world our children will live in the future. So let’s work hard over these next three days to elect ones we know will make us proud.
Thanks so much,
Jeff Goldblum

SUPPORTERS OF “RANKED CHOICE” JULIE ALSO PANIC OVER REPUBLICAN BRAD KLIPPERT’S CAMPAIGN FOR SECRETARY OF STATE

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Nov. 6, 2022, Kennewick, WA. Brandi Kruse, host of the show Undivided, came out swinging for her preferred candidate in
Washington’s hotly contested Secretary of State Race. Kruse managed to insult just about everyone in her surprisingly divisive
opinion. Kruse claimed Democrats were being cynically manipulative by releasing a video statement urging voters to “NOT write in
Brad Klippert for Secretary of State this election.”

Then Kruse pivoted to scold Republicans for not giving up after the August primary when Republican candidates split the vote. She
said that Republicans should accept defeat and sleep in the bed they made. Finally, Kruse made a personal pitch for non-partisan
candidate Julie Anderson. Brad Klippert’s write-in campaign for Secretary of State clearly has both Democrats and Anderson
supporters very, very worried.

Here’s some facts that Kruse is ignoring when she discusses the Washington Secretary of State Race:

Julie Anderson got just 12.8% of the vote in the August primary. She's clearly NOT the favorite of the voters. Anderson also
supports ranked choice voting, which is just another way to make elections less secure, less transparent and disenfranchise
voters. Most Republicans believe that Anderson’s support of ranked choice voting puts her on the side of those working to destroy
election integrity and transparency.

The next fact to consider is that Republican candidates got almost 40% of the votes in the primary. The voters clearly want a
Republican in this office.

Klippert, a seven-term state legislator, vows to work with the legislature to end illegal ballot harvesting, vote by mail,
motor-voter and many other “legal” ways to cheat that have been introduced into law over the many years of one-party Democratic
control of the Washington state legislature.

Rep. Klippert has been endorsed by the Washington State Republican Party, and 31 out of 39 of the county GOP Committees.

The Write-in Klippert Campaign is gaining the attention of the voters and has increasing momentum as the voters prepare to cast
their ballots on November 8th. The opinions of Kruse and the Democrat Party have clarified for Republican and Independent voters
the importance of Writing in Brad Klippert for Secretary of State.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
A poll from the gold-standard Des Moines Register showed I am only THREE points behind Grassley polls, so of course, I’ve been facing millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.
**There’s less than 48 hours until voting ends, and right now we’re still short of our $50,000 expanded GOTV goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask:**

| | | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE MONDAY, NOVEMBER 7
LOEFFLER CALLS FOR ETHICS INVESTIGATION INTO ABRAMS' NEW GEORGIA PROJECT
(ATLANTA) - Today, in a [letter](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Xz2lGSAr-t_INaUk1lFMf-JdPH1z4cxDxoDph8AwCsObD76iS8L9igU-JbW2MMu3ySMCf458h0kJlPItoXiCwyztNdK0Hb2vJJ2DmSDxTY0kp5CIQhdSwH-bFDp_TqdhJ_7CZ96OX1Cr367EuhYdTVP_steL5v9yq-o4iNvYzFT6JDSwfABND5CUs6BA_EbpYfcLuXqIQ8UM07QzaoAkdKeQAJK5HnKm94Et2MZ7-xM=&c=TFkLXi905YWcyMAvAtOHVL2TO3H1Ty1fnBT7FbEdD-DHI_s98E90Zg==&ch=MfwCeUHAy2FUwu6fXhHtygHAyxd_n91kAAmN1qAHqBmGFHoPI1aXRg==) to the Georgia State Ethics Commission, Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler called for a new investigation into Stacey Abrams' New Georgia Project (NGP), following a [bombshell report](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Xz2lGSAr-t_INaUk1lFMf-JdPH1z4cxDxoDph8AwCsObD76iS8L9igU-JbW2MMu3lcna-EmVXH0y8QbKiabzpFpWF6Jx3LxEewcaFNaipTQUUNNIDVA7wy9n9VNxew9nbMLvqqPlyHes-3bcjwV3uQEa-bWkeMterv2QB7ci8DQnVu4d5-q5kVqGTOFk-RRv-IV9iIFJfeC7LnjlHLkrbvXcMayquTACheNnHWCopMnZJNrRc7Mb9SKHAwW7CiRZn0S1_GZGzOZs911qLCNjyw==&c=TFkLXi905YWcyMAvAtOHVL2TO3H1Ty1fnBT7FbEdD-DHI_s98E90Zg==&ch=MfwCeUHAy2FUwu6fXhHtygHAyxd_n91kAAmN1qAHqBmGFHoPI1aXRg==) about the group's financial impropriety.
Among other revelations, the Washington Free Beacon last week exposed new details behind the sudden dismissal of NGP Chief Financial Officer Randall Frazier. According to a former NGP executive, Frazier was fired "after warning the group's leaders that they were engaged in potential financial impropriety and urging them to bring in a forensic accountant to right the ship." NGP later thwarted an attempt by independent auditors to evaluate the group's finances.
"Stacey Abrams founded the New Georgia Project, and Raphael Warnock served as its CEO until 2020. But the law is clear: 501(c)(4) nonprofit organizations cannot be used as campaign weapons in coordination with political candidates," Loeffler wrote in the letter. "Amidst a highly competitive governor's race and a senatorial race that may decide the balance of power in the U.S. Senate, the Georgia State Ethics Commission should review this matter to ensure neither Abrams nor Warnock illegally colluded with the New Georgia Project to gain an unfair advantage, and to investigate the nature of the group's financial impropriety."
NGP and other Abrams-affiliated groups have a long history of illicit behavior, especially as it relates to benefitting her political ambitions. The group is already under investigation for malfeasance in 2018, when it [illegally campaigned](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Xz2lGSAr-t_INaUk1lFMf-JdPH1z4cxDxoDph8AwCsObD76iS8L9igU-JbW2MMu3xtlxic_YV64Bvv4qJrJ2n245HAaUOo2IgcIl-YglDED9PXYvIoZ2cAP-IBmt4RNalCOin-sPhu8mtHbHLVXLB84H7KhIdkhXG16lG_XyB10QFocwWILcQUOdnv6QvCVOzPbFoNAxqwV2ewyI3G6i5IU9TyeHfUupovRnParxeKCXnfaz2UtgpLWcyFVKXQ0HmwMEK1Qg1CssFg42iT3ypQ==&c=TFkLXi905YWcyMAvAtOHVL2TO3H1Ty1fnBT7FbEdD-DHI_s98E90Zg==&ch=MfwCeUHAy2FUwu6fXhHtygHAyxd_n91kAAmN1qAHqBmGFHoPI1aXRg==) for Abrams and refused to disclose more than $4 million in contributions to her campaign. A separate Politico [report](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Xz2lGSAr-t_INaUk1lFMf-JdPH1z4cxDxoDph8AwCsObD76iS8L9igU-JbW2MMu3N-13wjfLbi5RGqXEsKCCq9GiMG1451rHpYynzJdgneKKF6B_2pw4E2515ZvmFSNBYbgVsStoOZM8FHTd-O0cyuWXNDabkavBqSOfoXAHtslCGL7B900wXwmJ13CBI5VgxXhqgyqCPyug5jFOQRQV4inRe-ujt5DPjh8syaYknpg=&c=TFkLXi905YWcyMAvAtOHVL2TO3H1Ty1fnBT7FbEdD-DHI_s98E90Zg==&ch=MfwCeUHAy2FUwu6fXhHtygHAyxd_n91kAAmN1qAHqBmGFHoPI1aXRg==) last week revealed that NGP's sister organization, Fair Fight Action, paid almost $10 million to Abrams' campaign chairwoman under the guise of "legal fees."

name: Emily Fulmer
subject: In Collierville, some candidates think housing shouldn’t be affordable. I’m running for Alderman to change that.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Emily Fulmer Campaign; Katy Ramsey, Treasurer
body:
www.collierville4all.com [www.collierville4all.com]
November 7, 2022
Dear friend,
I’m Emily Fulmer and I’m running for Collierville Alderman, Position 4. A couple weeks ago, we had our first and only public forum for candidates running for the Collierville Board of Aldermen. I talked about the need for districts that ensure everyone in Collierville is represented, diversity and youth voice in government, and affordable housing.
All of these issues and more are extremely important in order to move Collierville forward but the responses to questions about affordable housing made it clear why we need a fresh perspective on the Board of Alderman.
These were some of the responses by candidates and current Aldermen, including my opponent:
“If we had affordable housing in Collierville, none of us would be happy”.
“They can’t afford to purchase a home in Collierville. Collierville might be a place you want to be but you may not be able to afford it. So, you may not be able to buy in Collierville right away. You might have to buy somewhere and save your money.”
One candidate said we shouldn’t “lower our standards”, while acknowledging their child couldn’t even afford to live there.
My opponent said the Board of Alderman can’t do anything about the low wages workers make.
I disagree. You can hear my response below.
https://vimeo.com/767443328 [https://vimeo.com/767443328]
SUPPORT AFFORDABLE HOUSING IN COLLIERVILLE BY DONATING TO OUR CAMPAIGN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpforfulmer]
We need someone on the Collierville Board of Alderman who will advocate for solutions to affordable housing. We need someone in office who will champion higher wages for workers, innovative zoning laws, and equitable property appraisals.
I’m running because I can bring the perspective that we can and should ensure every Collierville resident and future Collierville resident has access to affordable housing.
It's the last day of our campaign. Can you rush a $22 contribution [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpforfulmer] to make sure we reach every voter we can and get them out to vote? Your support gets us closer to a Collierville for all, not just for some.
Thank you for your support,
Emily Fulmer
Candidate for Collierville Alderman, Position 4
P.S. Sign up for my newsletter [https://www.collierville4all.com/contact] to keep fighting for affordable housing in Collierville during this election and beyond.

All of these issues and more are extremely important in order to move Collierville forward but the responses to questions about affordable housing made it clear why we need a fresh perspective on the Board of Alderman. These were some of the responses by candidates and current Aldermen, including my opponent: “If we had affordable housing in Collierville, none of us would be happy”. “They can’t afford to purchase a home in Collierville. Collierville might be a place you want to be but you may not be able to afford it. So, you may not be able to buy in Collierville right away. You might have to buy somewhere and save your money.” One candidate said we shouldn’t “lower our standards”, while acknowledging their child couldn’t even afford to live there. My opponent said the Board of Alderman can’t do anything about the low wages workers make. I disagree. You can hear my response below. [] SUPPORT AFFORDABLE HOUSING IN COLLIERVILLE BY DONATING TO OUR CAMPAIGN [] We need someone on the Collierville Board of Alderman who will advocate for solutions to affordable housing. We need someone in office who will champion higher wages for workers, innovative zoning laws, and equitable property appraisals. I’m running because I can bring the perspective that we can and should ensure every Collierville resident and future Collierville resident has access to affordable housing. It's the last day of our campaign. Can you rush a $22 contribution [] to make sure we reach every voter we can and get them out to vote? Your support gets us closer to a Collierville for all, not just for some. Thank you for your support, Emily Fulmer Candidate for Collierville Alderman, Position 4 P.S. Sign up for my newsletter [] to keep fighting for affordable housing in Collierville during this election and beyond. [] Paid for by Friends of Emily Fulmer Campaign; Katy Ramsey, Treasurer. The maximum donation is $1,600 per individual, $3,200 per couple, $8,300 per PAC. Please provide occupation and employer information for individual donations greater than $100 . Checks, made payable to Friends of Emily Fulmer, can be mailed to us at Friends of Emily Fulmer, 4515 Planters Trace Lane, Collierville, TN 38017. But it’s always been an important day for our family. It’s a brief moment to pause and reflect on the incredible people of Pennsylvania, the values that have kept us going forward, and the profound debt we owe to supporters, volunteers, and each other. Millions of Pennsylvanians will leave their house, get in their car or on the subway, and head to the polls tomorrow. In many ways tomorrow will be similar to past Election Days — but unlike past Election Days in Pennsylvania, our rights, freedoms, and our very democracy are on the ballot like never before. That’s why we’re spending the last 24 hours of this campaign making an all out push to get every last voter to the polls – because it’s simple: when we vote, we win. From a last minute ad blitz to texting and calling hundreds of thousands of voters, there’s so much work that we need to do before the clock runs out on this election. subject: It's a make-or-break moment
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Matt Gaetz_
body:
Dear Peter,

**This is a make-or-break moment.**

The midterm election is tomorrow.

And my campaign is still short of the $10,000 goal for the Election Day Victory Blitz.

_The MAGA movement must oust the regime from power and elect a pro-Trump majority that will put America First_.

name: Kathryn Shelton
subject: Tomorrow is the big day
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90471/images/PDP%20Primary%20Logo.png]
Dear Peter,
Election Day is tomorrow!
https://www.padems.com/vote/ [https://www.padems.com/vote/]
Before you head out to vote tomorrow, confirm your polling place now [https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/Pages/PollingPlaceInfo.aspx] .
The polls will be open from 7 AM to 8 PM tomorrow. Take your ID if you are voting at a new polling location. Remember, if you are in line by 8 PM, stay in line to cast your ballot.
If you plan to vote by mail and haven’t returned your mail-in ballot, keep in mind that your ballot has to be received by 8 PM tomorrow. Postmarked dates are not considered. Find an official drop-off location [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Resources/Pages/Contact-Your-Election-Officials.aspx?emci=a7ac8777-d85a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=%7B%7BContactsEmailID%7D%7D] and return it ASAP!
Before you return your mail-in ballot, make sure you have placed and sealed the ballot in the secrecy envelope and then the ballot return envelope. Double-check that you’ve signed and dated your voter declaration. Your mail-in ballot won’t be counted unless it is properly sealed, signed, and dated.
If you need immediate support or encounter problems at your polling place, call our Voter Assistance Hotline at 833-PAVOTES (833-728-6837) .
Check out our voter resources page for more information. [https://www.padems.com/vote/]
Vote like your life depends on it. Reproductive rights, voting rights, and healthcare are all on the line.
See you at the polls!
Kathryn Shelton
Voter Protection Director
All In PA
PA Democratic Party
229 State Street
Harrisburg, PA 17101
United States
https://www.padems.com [https://www.padems.com]

clean_body: I hope to earn your vote. | | | | | ---|---|--- Peter, I want to start by taking a moment to recognize your incredible support. Without you, we couldn’t have made it this far. Tomorrow is Election Day. When I launched my campaign, I ran on believing in the promise of America. I still believe the American Dream is alive and well, but the government has gotten in the way. In the past couple of years, they forced us to lock down our businesses, passed legislation that crushed middle-class families, and vilified our police—leaving us with the consequences. The government exists to work for us, but in the last two years, they have done nothing but make our life harder. I’m running to fix this mess; to bring common sense back to Washington. I will work to cut inflation, focus on making America-energy independent, restore our liberties, and bring our voice back to Washington. Make sure you get out and vote tomorrow, and tell your friends and family in Chester and Berks Counties to vote Guy! Thank you, Guy Ciarrocchi | | | ---|---|--- | | | | Our Guy For Congress, P.O. Box 515, Glenmoore, PA

subject: We’re in trouble

body:
| | |
---
Friend —
I’ve served my country in the Navy, at NASA, and now in the Senate.
No matter where I’ve been or what I was doing, I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions.
And right now, the facts tell me that we’re in trouble.

Friends and Supporters,
I have good news. Early and mail in voting numbers are in, and turnout is down significantly in Massachusetts. In 2020, 65% of the people voted early and by mail before election day. This election cycle, as of last Friday, only 19% of the electorate voted early and by mail. This means the majority of voters are showing up tomorrow November 8th to vote, in person at the polls. This is exactly what we need. Our side just needs to turn out tomorrow! Help Us Get Voters to Show Up.
I am asking for your help to reach voters before tomorrow in any way you can. If you cannot help you can always donate. We must have a strong "GET OUT THE VOTE EFFORT" on TUESDAY!

Go out to a Supermarket in the District this afternoon and hand out Caroline's literature.
Hold a sign on election day at the polls.
Make phone calls today and tomorrow. Can you text voters?
Click on any task displayed in the above boxes and let us know you can help. Someone from our campaign will be in touch with you with instructions and lists.
Weather is supposed to be good on Tuesday. It is important we have a presence at every location. Massachusetts must see a RED WAVE ON TUESDAY.
Here is a list of cities and towns in the district:
Arlington - Bedford - Belmont - Cambridge - Framingham - Lexington - Lincoln - Malden - Maynard - Medford - Melrose - Natick - Revere - Stoneham - Sudbury - Waltham - Watertown - Wayland - Wellesley - Weston - Winchester - Woburn - and Winthrop
Signs and literature are both available at 4 Patrick Circle in Stoneham in the driveway. You can take what you need.
Too much is at stake in this election. Massachusetts must ride the red wave. Your help is greatly appreciated. Thank you.
To Victory, Team Caroline

Fellow American - I don't want to go to overtime on Wednesday, November 9th.

**Georgia is one of a handful of states that mandates a runoff election for races where no candidate receives more than 50% of the vote. When I played football, we called that OVERTIME!**

I don't know about you, but I'd rather win this race without a runoff. However, according to a recent FiveThirtyEight forecast, no candidate is above 50%. See below:

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a441f474f1ed488c82b6a2f3fee38e30&_e=eiPhstqagE9-WO4lH-xMUyYQC82iGgXK26cuOqwke-72rGOowDjRneiWfaN2XXk-apC81ASYx56qN2vjDrH4y6dcpcpVXdohX8Ga1ktcAc3nODInMxIpqYj6g5ey3ASiZB4OHZh9QPPjHgndPzkl4d3i-PNGQ77gkNptFI-FiLNbNKM8J8NlSVgcLMV-nf4xwxc8QZ0OAyI4Qu3XNbtnHltPjeE_iR5cX4Sk0FywF3WQNlDK9QM3hJ0dSUkBVgZZ8iC8ChxhWHNU_oB8rqTX4P8l8_V17MEUS72UK7bTLlFoOBL5tzJDZhLnrMoFU_3qyf51abWgkE_6_ocHD1cW2kIeZP4YajTKh5xJTGpaY1ufx1MD5QXvpfRjZlfiIJ6t0OgrNuORuooKByymGUFbUQ%3D%3D)
**I want all of us to enjoy the Thanksgiving holiday without political ads!** Turkey, cranberry sauce, football, and naps are calling our names. However, if we don't win 50% of the votes tomorrow, I'm afraid the campaign will be going strong during Thanksgiving week.

So, in the spirit of putting this Senate campaign to bed successfully tomorrow evening, **[will you chip in $10 today to help us fund our massive Get-Out-The-Vote operation?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a441f474f1ed488c82b6a2f3fee38e30&_e=eiPhstqagE9-WO4lH-xMUyYQC82iGgXK26cuOqwke-72rGOowDjRneiWfaN2XXk-apC81ASYx56qN2vjDrH4y6dcpcpVXdohX8Ga1ktcAc3nODInMxIpqYj6g5ey3ASiZB4OHZh9QPPjHgndPzkl4d3i-PNGQ77gkNptFI-FiLNbNKM8J8NlSVgcLMV-nf4xwxc8QZ0OAyI4Qu3XNbtnHltPjeE_iR5cX4Sk0FywF3WQNlDK9QM3hJ0dSUkBVgZZBxLZtWU6msh3B49K5JC5BvUwzHIuFYqL5qa-0luVsDLFxoZ9B0JoE8VU_22ovDAqXM5msRb930AGqCK1pvfDsMvqVIwKIxpsYfU7adkNhTMgoTyukNYR_HIOb6oidiwAfto8qQbJx_expYMt5rl7Bg%3D%3D)**

clean_body: I want all of us to enjoy the Thanksgiving holiday without political ads! | Fellow American - I don't want to go to overtime on Wednesday, November 9th. Georgia is one of a handful of states that mandates a runoff election for races where no candidate receives more than 50% of the vote. When I played football, we called that OVERTIME! I don't know about you, but I'd rather win this race without a runoff. However, according to a recent FiveThirtyEight forecast, no candidate is above 50%. See below: I want all of us to enjoy the Thanksgiving holiday without political ads! Turkey, cranberry sauce, football, and naps are calling our names. However, if we don't win 50% of the votes tomorrow, I'm afraid the campaign will be going strong during Thanksgiving week. | Peter, Tonight I am having a Virtual Q&A. This is the last time before the elections. Most politicians hide in the basement and do not want to answer the people's questions. I have tried to do just the opposite. If you, your family or friends have questions for me, or questions about my Keep Idaho IDAHO plan, then join me tonight! Click here to register: <https://www.votebundy.com/campaign-events/virtual-townhall/> Also, I'm sure you have heard the "splitting the vote" narrative out there. It is Brad Little's last hope in getting Idaho conservatives to vote for him. But Idahoans shouldn't fall for this false narrative any longer. In fact it is laughable! Here are the numbers to prove that the Democrat nominee has absolutely no chance of winning no matter how the vote is split between Little and I. The Democrat party knows that their nominee does not have any chance, so they have not supported him at all. The Democrat nominee has only had 132 contributions to his campaign, totaling less than $10,000 in donations. He has put in $14,000 of his own money just to keep the campaign alive. No one knows his name, no one has seen a sign from him, or any campaign ads. He simply is a non-issue in this election. To further refute the establishment's fear tactic of splitting the vote and getting a Democrat in, here are the actual numbers of registered voters in Idaho. When you do the math there is simply no possible way the Dems can win a state-wide election in Idaho this year. See for yourself...
_**Idaho Registered Voters**_ Registered Republicans: 588,461Registered Democrats: 132,389Registered Unaffiliated: 296,052Registered Constitutional/Libertarian: 15,464
So do the math. Even if half of the unaffiliated voters cast their vote for the Democrat (which will just not happen) and ALL the Democrat voters voted for him (which will just not happen either) the Democrat nominee _still_ does not come close to getting enough votes to win. Now, break it down between Little and I. Take out the Democrat voters and take out half of the unaffiliated voters from the total registered voters and you end up with 73% of the voters either for Little or for me. In order to split the vote, and allow the Democrat to get in, the conservative voting pool would need to be below 66%. It's not even close - it's at 73%. It is laughable to think that the Idaho Establishment is still using the "split the vote" narrative and that some Idahoans are still falling for it. No matter how you do the math, this race is between Brad Little and Ammon Bundy and I have laid it out there in full display of what I plan on doing to Keep Idaho IDAHO! Sincerely, Ammon Bundy
Share this information with this link: <https://votebundy.com/go/14669b2c-5801-470f-b28d-a5a09bb79874>
P.S. Even if you are not registered to vote, you can still vote by going down to your voting place and showing your ID and proof of residency. Vote Bundy tomorrow! (Nov 8th)

I'm in between our final meetings before Election Day so I'll cut to the chase:
[**Our Republican leadership team is finalizing our last voter mobilization efforts before the 2022 midterm elections and we 're short just $10,000 we need to keep our ads up until the last race is called. I know it's a last-minute request but would you be willing to chip in $27 (our average online contribution) to make sure our operations don't run out of fuel?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61815379:JXtZhkGNK:m:1:3346849603:C3F67C0D922768017EEAFB16D171C5E5:r)

Look:
Exactly ZERO races have been called and the polls are all over the place. We can't take anything for granted. There's too much at stake for the future of our country to take our foot off the gas. I'm personally asking you do donate $27 before the Democrats...
\-- Implement CRT in every classroom in America
\-- Greenlight abortion-on-demand in all 50 states
\-- Open our borders to illegal immigration
\-- Eliminate domestic oil production altogether
\-- Completely destroy our God-given rights
So you must decide: Who do you want in control of the levers of power?
**America First Republicans or the Radical Left Democrats.**
There are a few dozen House races that are too close to call and whatever we do (or don't do) in these final hours will determine who wins... and who loses. If we fail to raise this last $10,000 before Election Day, we'll be leaving the House Majority up to a coin flip.
[**This is the most important request I 've ever made of you. Please donate $27 (the amount most people give) before the polls open first thing tomorrow.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61815379:JXtZhkGNK:m:1:3346849603:C3F67C0D922768017EEAFB16D171C5E5:r)
To victory,
Steve Scalise (Republican Whip

We'll say it straight: we're being outraised. And if we sit here and do nothing, Pelosi and the Democrats will buy this election from under us. [**If you 've been waiting to step up, now is the time. Everything President Trump worked so hard to build -- our Conservative Supreme Court Majority, a secure border, a booming economy, HIS ENTIRE LEGACY -- is on the line.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61815380:JXtZhkGNK:m:1:3346849603:C3F67C0D922768017EEAFB16D171C5E5:r)
We still have time to turn things around, but we need to act fast. Whether we win or lose will come down to what you do in this moment.
\-- Steve Scalise, House Republican Whip

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6356%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=ecyfd92arDgQyVIKWXwmmQ&sysid=1)
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c81511%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Gd0G%2fLicUc1xkfDQkNYZWw&sysid=1 "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c81512%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=tl%2f2TQSAFVlnfj%2bvw8gb%2fA&sysid=1 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c81513%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=omXl2IWJCXr2nQ2rTyZvwg&sysid=1 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c81514%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fqXmqRJY1iZMMMzz2vmnBA&sysid=1 "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c81525%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oXhoslEN3hg6%2fpvFxz8D9w&sysid=1 "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran
gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c81526%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7hYhen2oaAJrhmm0ktYmGA&sysid=1 "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer,
breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c81527%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=N7D3BIObeYqXs%2fYghbHQ0g&sysid=1 "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for
our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c81528%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dIJURFSa5vtZGEu%2bCJ5yWw&sysid=1 "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I’ve shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c81529%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rIUTTV1Uz7WIcg85a8yKkQ&sysid=1 "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and
end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can’t do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c81520%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=s2ReVfCFXhpTq9gVrJWiWg&sysid=1 "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks
to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c81521%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dPhg7irzIOWun4JKyR5wfA&sysid=1 "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c81522%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SjdSpVSFJjU858LrLITVWw&sysid=1 "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

name: marisa wood (personal)
subject: re: my final pitch
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marisa Wood for Congress
body:
Friend -- we’re in the final 36 hours of the primary election, and the final batches of CA-20 ballots are being mailed in.
Anything can happen between today and tomorrow, so I hope you’ll give me just 3 minutes to make a case for why you should consider supporting my campaign to unseat far-right extremist Kevin McCarthy.
Here’s my story:
**Like many residents in our community, starting my life in the Central Valley wasn’t easy.** My husband John and I struggled early on to make ends meet, and we raised our three children on the apple orchard where he worked.
**I’ve been a public school teacher in this district for over 20 years.** Education is our most powerful tool to stay competitive in the global marketplace, support future generations, and learn to respect one another’s differences. A big part of being a successful representative is teaching and learning -- two qualities that my opponent, Kevin McCarthy, lacks.
**McCarthy’s nearly four-decade-long political career deeply entrenched him in the Republican establishment.** Despite being elected to serve the constituents of the Central Valley, he has never delivered on making our communities safer, healthier, or more habitable for future generations.
**I’m not a politician, folks.** I know the challenges families in our community are facing because I’ve faced them myself. We need jobs that pay the bills, access to affordable healthcare, and a dignified minimum wage for all hard-working Americans.
**The Central Valley and High Desert deserve a representative who’s walked a mile in their shoes.** My opponent Kevin McCarthy is out of touch with the problems we’re facing. He’s a career politician who’d rather push his own political agenda and create partisan gridlock than fight for his constituents.
**I know I’m the strongest Democratic McCarthy has ever faced, but I need your help to make sure he’s never handed the Speaker’s Gavel. Will you chip in $5 by midnight to help fund our last push to turn out voters and DEFEAT Kevin McCarthy once and for all?**

| Peter,

| | | Peter,Election day is tomorrow, and Virginia has a real hope of getting rid of woke progressive Abigail Spanberger and her radical agenda.Now, Spanberger is running around claiming to be a moderate. She’s not. No moderate supports forced child mutilation (“gender transition”) or keeping parents in the dark about what groomers are telling their kids.[**That’s why we’re proud to be airing this hard-hitting ad exposing Abigail Spanberger and her allies’ crazy transgender agenda.**](https://ccpac.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b9287aa21abd9b2f559027f2&id=75e2e1832e&e=4d48d38c58) Peter, we’re able to keep the ad on air longer now thanks to the generous support of Virginians like you who have had enough. And the longer it’s on air, the more people know the truth — and the more votes Abigail Spanberger loses.So please share the ad around to people who need to see it.[**Please also consider attending Yesli Vega’s event tomorrow evening with Governor Youngkin for a final rally to get out the vote.**](https://ccpac.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b9287aa21abd9b2f559027f2&id=de486f426c&e=4d48d38c58)

name: Cheri Beasley
subject: No regrets
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
| | | Friends — When I kicked off this campaign, I promised this team and North Carolina that we would work harder than we ever have to turn our state blue. I don’t want any of us to wake up on Wednesday morning with regrets. Team, **tomorrow is Election Day** : the day we’ve been working toward. I first announced I was running for Congress in New Mexico’s 2nd congressional district in September 2021 because I was tired of seeing my home represented by a far-right extremist whose voting record has clearly ignored the needs of the people she was elected to serve. Wade_ , and backing legislation to ban abortion nationwide with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. subject: You might not have heard much about this race because nobody gave Democrat, Admiral Mike Franken, a chance. But Sen. Grassley is unpopular with Iowans, and Adm. Franken can win this race, which is now rated as a pure toss-up. Help the Franken campaign get voters to the polls tomorrow?
body:
Your help matters in Iowa
| | | | |
---
| | | _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc7b00316-bc12-4e8c-908f-009a13238df3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| | | | | Peter, **_We have expanded the playing field and just like that there's a new Senate race we can win!!_** **You may not have heard about this race because nobody gave Democrat, Admiral Mike Franken, a chance. He's running against Chuck Grassley, you see, who may have been in Washington since the automobile was invented.** _(Okay, Grassley’s only been in the Senate since 1981. But still.)_ [**Will you please join us by giving $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to help retire Chuck Grassley (FINALLY!) and send Admiral Mike Franken to the U.S. Senate?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9feecc9f-b290-4a29-b02e-163652896f84/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
|
---
| | | | [**DONATE NOW: ADM. FRANKEN FOR IOWA**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T23fcf7ed-f26f-475b-8402-78523b9c192d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| **_But Grassley's changed over that time. He was in on Donald Trump's plot to overthrow our government--tweeting out on January 6th that he'd be certifying the electoral votes, not the Vice President. It was a lie. He claimed that the Affordable Care Act would "create death panels" and "pull the plug on grandma," the kind of dishonest garbage you'd expect from Alex Jones, not a longtime Senator._** Grassley consistently repeats right-wing conspiracies like the one that led to the attempted assassination of Nancy Pelosi (and nearly got her husband, Paul, killed). And he wants to suppress voting rights, which sadly is consistent with the shameful blemish attached to his name for all eternity--his vote against making Martin Luther King, Jr. day a federal holiday in the 1980s. **_Mike Franken achieved the incredible distinction of becoming an admiral by not betraying his country like Grassley, but defending it. It seems Iowans have caught on, as the latest Des Moines Register poll has Mike within 3 points of Grassley, trailing 46%-43% with likely voters. Within the margin of error!_** **_All of the major prognosticators have moved the race to a pure toss-up. Grassley is unpopular with Iowans, with Two-thirds believing he’s too old (89) to be running for another 6-year term. Franken. Can. Win. This. Race._** [**Can you please join us by giving $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to help retire Chuck Grassley (FINALLY!) and send Admiral Mike Franken to the U.S. Senate?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf07a1bd7-9656-4d3d-8025-08c3729db13e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **Thank****you, my friends,**** for continuing to fight right up to the election.** **Cliff Schecter**

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! body:
Please make sure you get out and vote for Geoff and Leah
| | | |
---
| VOTE FOR GEOFF AND LEAH ON TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 8
---
| Dear Friend,
The essence of freedom is the ability to make choices that lead to a better life for you and your family.
That's precisely the choice you're being asked to make at the ballot box tomorrow. I humbly ask for your vote for Governor on Tuesday, Nov. 8, because I respectfully believe the Diehl-Allen ticket uniquely represents the ideals that will help create a better life for you and your family here in Massachusetts.
I believe in lowering the cost of living so you'll have enough money to buy gas, groceries, and home heating fuel this winter. My opponents believe your financial security is less important than their need to virtue signal radical political causes they hold dear - like when Maura Healey blocked two gas pipelines from coming into this state, sending natural gas prices soaring.
I believe you should have an opportunity to get a better job, which means I support small businesses and growing our state's economy. My opponents? They are in favor of higher taxes that punish success and that will force companies to leave our state, sending that job you wanted elsewhere.
I oppose mandates. I oppose the state telling you that you need to get a COVID shot to keep your job or participate in society, or that your kids need to get a COVID shot just to attend school. Speaking of your kids, I'm also opposed to them learning lessons at school which go against what you would teach them at home. I believe in school choice and having a Parents' Bill of Rights. My opponents? They believe they know better when it comes to you, your health, and your kids. They're always ready to tell you what to do, and if you disagree with their "science," they're ready to shut down your school, close your business, and take away your job. They know how - they did it before and they won't hesitate to do it again.
Maura Healey and Kim Driscoll are for bigger government that takes away your money and freedom to serve the special interests and their own political interests. They even want to give driver's licenses to illegal immigrants. I disagree. By contrast, I'm for a limited government that serves the people's interests, one that lets you keep your hard-earned money, respects your freedom, and prizes your opportunity to succeed. So is my running mate, Leah Allen. Together, we are also the only candidates in this race who can bring balance and accountability to the one-party rule that dominates Beacon Hill.
The choice is yours. Please take a moment to vote on Tuesday; don't leave the decision up to someone else. And when you do vote, I would be grateful if you would please choose me to be our state's next Governor and Leah Allen to be our next Lieutenant Governor. We promise to work hard on your behalf and to make decisions that will help ensure a better future for you and your family.
Thank you.
Sincerely,

subject: Free the political prisoners held here in Montgomery County!
body:
Catherine Engelbrecht & Gregg Phillips...

| | | |
---
**FELLOW PATRIOTS:**
About a week ago, True the Vote leaders Catherine Engelbrecht and Gregg Phillips were arrested after refusing to disclose the name of a confidential informant who supposedly helped them investigate election software company Konnech.

They were only supposed to be held for 24 hours... but those 24 hours turned into a week.

Here's my question...

If 2000 Mules was a 'fantasy film,' as the left claims, then why the heck are Catherine Engelbrecht and Gregg Phillips STILL in jail?

Hi friend,

Tomorrow is Election Day! This is your chance to have your voice heard and show that Minnesotans want a leader who will work hard for all of us.

We know what’s at stake in this election: the rising cost of living, reproductive rights, Social Security... and the very future of our nation’s democracy. That’s why it’s so important that, in addition to voting tomorrow, you make a plan ahead of time and bring your friends and family as well.

Let’s make a plan to vote together.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54233451/377869957/1349738330?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MjBiMjcyMy1jZDVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7Y3iZfIyml0A4uA6mJNiORg0oQnXaMW6wQGMfevmLKM=&emci=290d1dde-c95e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=920b2723-cd5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=5460736)

* Polls are open from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. What time will you be arriving to vote?

* How are you getting to the polls? Do you need to ask a friend or neighbor for a ride? Can you offer your friends and neighbors a ride?

* Which of your family and friends can you bring? Contact them today and make a plan!

Remember as long as you're in line by 8:00 p.m., you can vote! Even if you do not reach the front of the line until after 8:00 p.m.

Thank you so much for all your support. We couldn’t have come this far without you. Together we will show the nation what Southern Minnesota values are all about.

See you at the polls tomorrow!
Team Jeff

body:
I want you to know where you’ve made your investment — who exactly you’re betting on in this election.

Derek, We officially have _less than one day left_ on this campaign. And I wanted to let you know exactly where your donations will go in the last stretch of this campaign. **But first, I have to be upfront: we have a lot left to do in the final stretch.** **[We have thousands of volunteers to mobilize and countless voters to reach before polls close tomorrow. With so little time left, I’m counting on this grassroots team to dig deeper than ever. Will you invest any amount and split a donation between my campaign and Josh Shapiro right now? Your support can make the difference in races that will be decided by the narrowest of margins, Derek.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54235626/377876628/221824738?refcode=email_110722_abrams_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=576e7062-ce5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NzZlNzA2Mi1jZTVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZT1X-IAutVbefKkICJA4nNduAni_T3L5p1WOhLXz1hw=)** With your investment today, we will keep building on the massive turnout and send shockwaves through the nation on Election Night. We can get one more ad up on TV, the radio, online. We can send yard signs to that one extra neighborhood. We can knock one more street of doors. We can get one more volunteer to speak directly with voters in their community. **All of that is still possible — but only if you invest today.** More than the tactics that will win this race, though, I want you to know where you’ve made your investment — who exactly you’re betting on in this election. _You’re betting on the woman in Savannah who wants to expand her small business._ _On the first-generation college student from Macon who wants to become a doctor someday._ _On the second grader in Augusta who wants to feel as safe in the classroom as he does at home._ _On the mother of three in Atlanta who wants to put a down payment on her first home._ By making your contribution today, you’re investing in _them_ , Derek. Georgians whose dreams have been shut down by systems that have worked against them for centuries. Georgians who’ve become jaded by the structures that have counted them out. name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: before the polls open
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
Missourians deserve a senator who will put politics aside, put people first, and work to make sure that everyone is able to live out the American Dream.
| | |
---
Peter,

I’m Trudy Busch Valentine: A nurse, mother, children’s advocate, proud fourth-generation Missourian – and **tomorrow, my community will head to the polls and see my name on the ballot for U.S. Senate.** I’ve spent my life giving back and helping others, and now I’m running to do the same thing in Washington. Before polls close, I wanted to share why I'm in this race one last time.
As a young girl growing up in Missouri, I watched my parents live the American Dream. They always told me: “To whom much is given, much is expected.” That sense of duty to help others is what drove me to choose a life of service.

It’s why I volunteered as a candy striper when I was only 13 years old. It’s what led me to attend nursing school, work in hospitals, and later, work for the Salvation Army.
It’s also why I decided to run for U.S. Senate – **because Missourians deserve a senator who will put politics aside, put people first, and work to make sure that everyone is able to live out the American Dream. Now, with polls opening tomorrow morning, I need to hear from top Democratic supporters like you, Peter. **
**[**So I'm asking a favor: Could you please take a few minutes to complete our campaign's FINAL election priorities survey? Your feedback is essential to helping me understand where to focus our efforts so that we** can hit the ground running after we win this election.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54236598/377877477/740245734?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk435-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5Yjc0NzIxMy1jZjVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uPvWjOi4_T2VjsjDrSlEOQeGtEanC_dS2wTebcIkbmE=&emci=808b4bd5-6e5c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=9b747213-cf5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=4450063)**

Too many Missourians have had to fight to get the healthcare they need. Too many Missourians have an eviction notice on their door. Too many Missourians have worried about paying their electric bill. It just isn't right.
These days, the American Dream seems to come with a price tag – and that price is way too high. That’s why I’m ready to help lower the cost of basic necessities. I’m ready to expand access to affordable healthcare. I’m ready to fight for a woman’s right to choose. And I’m ready to put an end to our state’s tragic opioid epidemic.
Peter, we’ve known for too long that Washington is broken, with leaders dividing rather than uniting us. Missourians know that we need more compassion and less politics. To truly solve problems, we need leadership that puts politics aside and puts people first – and that’s exactly what I’m ready to do as your next U.S. senator.
But look: I believe leaders should talk less and listen more – and that’s why I’m reaching out to you as we enter the final hours of this campaign. **In just a few months, I will be in the halls of the Capitol advocating on your behalf.[Will you respond to my survey to tell me what my first priority should be? Your answers today will help guide our strategy to fix a broken Washington and rebuild our great state in the months ahead. I’d be so grateful for your input.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54236607/377877483/740245734?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk435-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5Yjc0NzIxMy1jZjVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uPvWjOi4_T2VjsjDrSlEOQeGtEanC_dS2wTebcIkbmE=&emci=808b4bd5-6e5c-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=9b747213-cf5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=4450063)**

Folks, I can’t believe we’re here.
Time is going by so fast, but here we are: **24 hours and counting** to #DefeatDeSantis. We’ve knocked on doors, we’ve made phone calls, and we’ve held events to get people ready to **VOTE.**
Election Day can get busy, and it’s so important to have a plan.
## _**[Make Your Plan to Vote](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54241092/377883976/-1612268846?refcode=20221107.01_org_em_gotv&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYjI2NTZlZS1kMjVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UHmnG_q_b66j9McDUkcqMcVyWBYAnG4nR2ifww75dKE=&emci=3eac38eb-bb5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=cb2656ee-d25e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8807089)**_
* Voting on Election Day November 8 means you can only vote at your _[**assigned precinct**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54241096/377883980/-628132722?refcode=20221107.01_org_em_gotv&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYjI2NTZlZS1kMjVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UHmnG_q_b66j9McDUkcqMcVyWBYAnG4nR2ifww75dKE=&emci=3eac38eb-bb5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=cb2656ee-d25e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8807089)_.
* If you vote at the wrong precinct, your vote will NOT count
* Even a provisional ballot will not count, so do not accept one from a poll worker; instead, go to your [_**assigned precinct**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54241100/377883984/-628132722?refcode=20221107.01_org_em_gotv&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYjI2NTZlZS1kMjVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UHmnG_q_b66j9McDUkcqMcVyWBYAnG4nR2ifww75dKE=&emci=3eac38eb-bb5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=cb2656ee-d25e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8807089).
* If you recently moved and have a new precinct, you have to go to the new precinct and ask a poll worker to help you update your address. Then you’ll be able to vote a regular ballot.
* The address on your ID **DOES NOT** have to match your current address in order for you to vote a regular ballot.
* You need to bring a photo ID and a signature ID when you go to vote. This can be an ID that has both, like a Florida driver’s license, or a credit card with a signature and a student ID with your picture on it.
* If you experience any problems voting, please call the Voter Assistance Hotline at 1-833-VOTE-FLA (1-833-868-3352).

Please check the list below for some **free** and **discounted transportation** options in Florida on Election Day.
* _[Pasco County](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54241104/377883988/-1260843561?refcode=20221107.01_org_em_gotv&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYjI2NTZlZS1kMjVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UHmnG_q_b66j9McDUkcqMcVyWBYAnG4nR2ifww75dKE=&emci=3eac38eb-bb5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=cb2656ee-d25e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8807089)_ residents can enjoy FREE public transportation on November 8.
* Palm Beach County’s _[Palm Tran](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54241107/377883993/1847580973?refcode=20221107.01_org_em_gotv&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYjI2NTZlZS1kMjVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UHmnG_q_b66j9McDUkcqMcVyWBYAnG4nR2ifww75dKE=&emci=3eac38eb-bb5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=cb2656ee-d25e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8807089)_ is offering FREE rides to polling sites on November 8.
* _[Collier Area Transit](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54241110/377883996/2092560393?refcode=20221107.01_org_em_gotv&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYjI2NTZlZS1kMjVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UHmnG_q_b66j9McDUkcqMcVyWBYAnG4nR2ifww75dKE=&emci=3eac38eb-bb5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=cb2656ee-d25e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8807089)_ is offering free rides to polling locations on November 5.
* [_LYFT_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54241112/377883998/-2045143082?refcode=20221107.01_org_em_gotv&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYjI2NTZlZS1kMjVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UHmnG_q_b66j9McDUkcqMcVyWBYAnG4nR2ifww75dKE=&emci=3eac38eb-bb5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=cb2656ee-d25e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8807089) is offering 50% off rides, scooters and bikes to the polls on November 8.
* _[Faith in Florida](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54241115/377884000/-1401604092?refcode=20221107.01_org_em_gotv&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYjI2NTZlZS1kMjVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UHmnG_q_b66j9McDUkcqMcVyWBYAnG4nR2ifww75dKE=&emci=3eac38eb-bb5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=cb2656ee-d25e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8807089)_ is hosting statewide free shuttles to polling stations.

And there are even more opportunities out there, check your local county website for more information.
Please, wherever you are in our great sunshine state, please make sure you vote. The future of Florida depends on it. Thank you for going on this journey with me.
– Charlie Crist

name: Laura Nevitt,  Keystone Progress
subject: Are you ready to vote? We can help.

body:
https://www.kpef.info [https://www.kpef.info]

Dear Friend,

Are you ready to use your power when you cast your ballot tomorrow? If you're prepared, you'll be able to make sure your vote is counted! Here are some tips and resources to make sure you're ready to protect our rights and save our democracy at the polls.

Find your voting place HERE [https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/Pages/PollingPlaceInfo.aspx] . Only people voting for the first time at their polling place need to show ID.
If you have a disability, know that all polling places in PA must have at least one accessible voting system, either a separate system or the general voting system used by all voters. HERE [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Voting-in-PA/Pages/Accessible-Voting.aspx] is more info on accessible voting.

You can check a sample ballot for your precinct here [https://www.spotlightpa.org/elections] . Compare candidates and explore the ballot when you sign up on Vote Pro Choice. [https://www.voteprochoice.us/voter-guide] REMEMBER: Pennsylvania no longer has straight ticket voting, and you have to complete the entire ballot — make sure to check the back to see if you missed any races!

If you're voting by mail or absentee ballot, it must be received by 8 p.m. TOMORROW on Election Day, November 8. Bring your fully completed ballot to a drop box (find one here) [https://vote.pa/return/] or county election office (find yours here [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Resources/Pages/Contact-Your-Election-Officials.aspx] ) . Make sure it's signed, dated, and sealed.

Here [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Voting-in-PA/Pages/Mail-and-Absentee-Ballot.aspx] are details on how to fill out your mail-in or absentee ballot. If you didn't receive your ballot in the mail at all, then contact your local election office [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Resources/Pages/Contact-Your-Election-Officials.aspx] .

Any other questions? Click below.

KEYSTONE PROGRESS’ HOW TO VOTE GUIDE [https://www.kpef.info/pa-voter-guide]

If you have any trouble voting, you can call 866-OUR-VOTE [tel:8666878683] . Please forward this to your family and friends!

Let's make sure our voices are heard tomorrow at the polls!

Laura
Executive Director
Keystone Progress

Thank you for fighting for justice and equality alongside me. Whether you’ve been a part of my team from the very beginning or you joined during my re-election campaign, YOU have made a meaningful difference in our fight for reproductive rights, LGBTQ+ rights, and more.

| | | Election Day is TOMORROW and Republicans have been trying to convince everyone that the race is over, and that Democrats will sit this one out. But we say “That’s Bulls***!” Now let’s prove it. body:
It fills me with joy knowing that so many people believe in Mark just as I do.
#

Friends —
Election Day is tomorrow and Mark needs our help to hit his final fundraising goal of $1 million. And it is so important that we get him there, because a poll just showed Mark down 1 point against Blake Masters.
[**The stakes have never been higher, which is why I'm respectfully asking you to make one more $3 donation to Mark’s people-powered campaign to help him win this race.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-nov22.ftVLpg&refcode=em221107-1-7&t=1&akid=4717%2E6688874%2ENYyGM_)
When we launched this re-election campaign we knew that we would face many challenges. We knew we would be facing an uphill battle and that National Republicans would spare no expense to attack Mark.
And we were right about that, but what we didn’t know is that there would be so many people standing with Mark. Hundreds of thousands of people have supported Mark’s campaign and it fills me with joy knowing that so many people believe in Mark just as I do.
But now we have one final goal to accomplish together, and if we can knock it out like we have all the others I’m confident Mark can win this race. So what do you say?
[**If you are able, will you make a $3 donation to Mark’s people-powered campaign? This is his very last goal of the campaign and it would mean the world to me if you could pitch in for the first time before Election Day.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-nov22.ftVLpg&refcode=em221107-1-7&t=2&akid=4717%2E6688874%2ENYyGM_)

| | **[Donate $250](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1392?c0=mek-em-nov22.qOTp-u&refcode=em221107-1-7&t=25&akid=4717%2E6688874%2ENYyGM_)**

| **[Other Amount](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1395?c0=mek-em-nov22.xTY-rf&refcode=em221107-1-7&t=26&akid=4717%2E6688874%2ENYyGM_)**

****

Gabby Giffords

body:
| | | |
---
| | | Friends,

With just one more day before this election comes to a close, I want to thank you for your friendship and support over the past four years. Our team has worked hard to earn your support, and now we need your vote.

If you have not already voted, I encourage you to head to the polls and cast your ballot. Republicans must turn out in record numbers to ensure we keep Kansas red.

Early voting will continue until NOON today. Polls will be open from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. on Tuesday, November 8. Find your polling location and preview your ballot [HERE](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=437b37693a&e=e4cd931cf2).

It is an honor to serve as your Kansas Secretary of State, and I look forward to serving you for another four years.

All my best,
---
|

| Scott Schwab
Secretary of State

| | Peter, I've spent my entire life fighting for working people. Walking picket lines and attending union rallies with my dad before I was old enough to vote. Volunteering on local political campaigns when I was in high school. Organizing my community to elect candidates up and down the ballot who would fight for our priorities. Those are the values I took with me when I served in the legislature, passing bills to raise the minimum wage and provide Oregonians with paid sick days. Now, as Labor Commissioner, I fight for workers every day – combating wage theft and workplace discrimination and creating opportunities with our registered apprenticeship programs. **And those are the values that I'll take to Congress.** Let's be honest, Peter: Congress has too many multi-millionaires – in both parties – who can't relate to the struggles that our communities are facing right now because, quite frankly, it's not a part of their own experience. They can't understand it because they haven't lived it themselves. **When I'm in Congress, Oregon's working families will always be top of mind and first in line for me.** Thanks for being with me in That link will take you to the instructions, and you can start immediately! You will be able to text voters until the polls close on Tuesday, November 8th at 8:00 PM their local time.

| | Polling reveals that a majority of voters think Democrat leaders put the interests of illegal immigrants ahead of American citizens. In fact, voters agree that Republicans put Americans first, according to a [CBS poll.](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) The polling also shows that 59% of voters say that Democrat congressmen will “open the U.S.-Mexican border” if they keep control of Congress in 2023. It’s no wonder Americans are skeptical of the Left’s sympathies. The Biden administration just recently imported at least 3 million foreign workers and illegal immigrants to the country, adding to their track record of admitting at least [seven migrants for every 10 U.S. births in 2022.](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ2MDM3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/DKUQ6aznNzLLGdOn8inLmg)

---
[COMPLETE MY SURVEY](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
---
|
---
| | A Washington Post columnist has recently [called](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) President Biden and Vice President Harris unfit for office. Writer George Will, who [voted for Biden in 2020](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-VZbZPt55lBsxyw), formally implored Biden and Harris not to seek reelection to the White House in 2024. Will is not alone in his distaste for the Biden administration. A majority of Democrats don‘t want the sitting president to run again in 2024, according to [polling](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-MiiYSzVjw) from the _Economist_ and YouGov. Meanwhile, an overwhelming [71%](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-JWJTVoTZTfRe3R8N_Unig) of registered voters say the country under Biden’s leadership is headed in the wrong direction, while just 20% say it’s on the right track, according to a new NBC News survey. The Democrats are sure to dislike Biden even more after a midterm election disaster for their party. Harris, on the other hand, has burnt through “seasoned staff members who have succeeded in other demanding, high-profile positions,” according to the [Washington Post.](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bDhQ) "She sounds, as a critic has said, like someone giving a book report on a book she has not read," Will wrote. "Complacency and arrogance make a ruinous compound."

[](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)

| | | | | _Cliff here, _Peter _. We know you’re getting a lot of campaign messages right now, but I think you know, like we know, how much is riding on this election if we want candidates who support working families.

Take this Utah Senate race. It’s the first real chance Democrats have had in 50 years to have a Senator from Utah we could support. It puts a lot of pressure on Republicans to have to defend a Senate seat in a state that’s usually safe for them and that we could really win. Do we want wealthy conservatives to just walk away with this Senate race, and walk away with the Senate, like they have so many times before?_ _It’s down to what we want to see happen this Tuesday. Which campaign will have the resources to get more of their supporters to the polls? How do we want to feel when the votes come in on Election Night? Will we know we did all we could to make the outcome better for all Americans? It’s up to us, right now._ _And so I’ll leave the rest to the brave, the compassionate, Dr. Mary Trump ..._ [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3b739834-4aea-4663-8e7e-480b4685b4dd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _Peter,_ I’m writing to ask for your support in electing Evan McMullin to represent Utah in the U.S. Senate. But first, let me tell you about his far-right, anti-democracy opponent Mike Lee and why we must replace him this Tuesday. Mike Lee is dangerous, Peter. He’s the type of self-serving politician who will do and say anything in order to appease the extremists and special interest groups bankrolling his campaign. Sound familiar? It does to me, too.
