Do we want wealthy conservatives to just walk away with this Senate race, and walk away with the Senate, like they have so many times before? It’s down to what we want to see happen this Tuesday. Which campaign will have the resources to get more of their supporters to the polls? How do we want to feel when the votes come in on Election Night? Will we know we did all we could to make the outcome better for all Americans? It’s up to us, right now. And so I’ll leave the rest to the brave, the compassionate, Dr. Mary Trump ... Peter, I’m writing to ask for your support in electing Evan McMullin to represent Utah in the U.S. Senate. But first, let me tell you about his far-right, anti-democracy opponent Mike Lee and why we must replace him this Tuesday. Mike Lee is dangerous, Peter. He’s the type of self-serving politician who will do and say anything in order to appease the extremists and special interest groups bankrolling his campaign. Sound familiar? It does to me, too. | | | | | | | [[ Elect Evan McMullin → ]]() | In fact, Mike Lee conspired directly with my uncle’s administration to overturn the 2020 election and override the will of the American people. Friend, With the last day we have, I want to tell you why I’m giving my all for Brenda. I’ve been working with Brenda on her campaign since May, but I’ve known her personally my whole life. I want to say I’m so proud of her and all of her accomplishments and things she’s taught me throughout my life. Brenda is a proven fighter for people of Vermont. Now it’s our time to fight alongside her. When I had experienced sexual violence in the National Guard, Brenda was making phone calls to help me get home safely after being held hostage at base. When I got home it was my mom, dad, and Brenda there waiting for me. Brenda has taught me to stand up for what I believe in and keep fighting even when it gets hard. Now, it’s our turn to come out for her.

Our team has done everything we can. Brenda and I have been traveling all across Vermont meeting the wonderful people of this state. Now it’s up to you. I’ve had an opportunity to personally meet so many Vermonters in the last six months, and I’m so grateful to have you by our sides supporting us. clean_body: | | Friend, With the last day we have, I want to tell you why I’m giving my all for Brenda. I’ve been working with Brenda on her campaign since May, but I’ve known her personally my whole life. I want to say I’m so proud of her and all of her accomplishments and things she’s taught me throughout my life. Brenda is a proven fighter for people of Vermont. Now it’s our time to fight alongside her. When I had experienced sexual violence in the National Guard, Brenda was making phone calls to help me get home safely after being held hostage at base. When I got home it was my mom, dad, and Brenda there waiting for me. Brenda has taught me to stand up for what I believe in and keep fighting even when it gets hard. Now, it’s our turn to come out for her. | Our team has done everything we can. Brenda and I have been traveling all across Vermont meeting the wonderful people of this state. Now it’s up to you. I’ve had an opportunity to personally meet so many Vermonters in the last six months, and I’m so grateful to have you by our sides supporting us. If you’ve already voted, thank you; the work is not done. Please tell five of your friends who are either on the edge or haven’t voted yet why you’re on Team Brenda and make a plan to vote with them. We’re going to keep traveling all across the state for the next two days, but we need your support to finish strong. I know that we can support Brenda just as she has always supported us. Thank you, Mirra | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2022 Brenda for Vermont. All rights reserved.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Cooper for North Carolina
body:
Please, take a moment to read to the end. | Hi Peter. I hope you’re doing well. We’re just hours away from Election Day, and I need to reach out for your support one more time. This is the last fundraising request you'll get from me or my team before the midterms, Peter. Please, can you make your first contribution to help meet our FINAL fundraising goal of this election? We’re still over $4,000 short with only hours left. **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rc_email?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com_FinalRequest](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54257523/377906243/435245919?refcode=ea.cbf19727-df5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ms=ea.cbf19727-df5e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYmYxOTcyNy1kZjVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TsDrb4V-VemuRubwuTG1HPP4ESRNxBKc-6cW6iuUmAM=)** I know we’ve emailed you many times over the last days, weeks, and months. Our work in 2022 has focused on setting up our Democratic allies for success on Election Day tomorrow, but many of the races here in North Carolina look like they could be decided by just a few votes. body:
We have never done the fake “triple matches” or scare tactics you probably see elsewhere.
#

From the start of this campaign, we’ve tried to be as transparent as possible because there would be no campaign without the support of folks like you. That’s why we have never done the fake “triple matches” or scare tactics you probably see elsewhere.
Instead, I want you to know that when we ask it’s because it’s important. It’s because I know that $3 and $10 at a time will make a difference — even in these final 48 hours.
There are important investments we can still make to increase our door-knocking efforts, expand our voter protection team, and get our message in front of more voters.
[**So please, if you can, donate $3 to our campaign to flip North Carolina’s Senate seat. I would not ask if I did not believe this would make a difference.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-nov22.g3HOlK&refcode=em221107-1-MA&t=1&akid=2254%2E357359%2Ef8Mnl-)

****
We hustled all weekend — making countless stops across the state, rural and urban alike, to make sure nobody is counted out or forgotten.
[](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-nov22.g3HOlK&refcode=em221107-1-MA&t=26&akid=2254%2E357359%2Ef8Mnl-)
We’ve knocked on doors nonstop and greeted folks at polling sites.
[](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-nov22.g3HOlK&refcode=em221107-1-MA&t=27&akid=2254%2E357359%2Ef8Mnl-)
The energy and enthusiasm on the ground here is real, and it’s absolutely going to come down to turn out. What we can accomplish in these remaining hours will make the difference.
[](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-nov22.g3HOlK&refcode=em221107-1-MA&t=28&akid=2254%2E357359%2Ef8Mnl-)
We are giving it our all — running to win. I truly believe our job is to use every dollar you give as effectively and efficiently as possible. And there are still important investments we can make today that will pay dividends when the votes are counted.
[**Will you please contribute $3 to our campaign to turn out every single vote we can before polls close tomorrow? Anything you can spare today gets put to work immediately to help us organize in all 100 counties and get more of our supporters to the polls.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-nov22.g3HOlK&refcode=em221107-1-MA&t=29&akid=2254%2E357359%2Ef8Mnl-)

There is no time to waste, so thank you in advance for your support.
\- Cheri Beasley

Friends,
I know you’ve been hearing from me a lot lately, but I promise this will be the last time I email you today. We have until then to do everything we can to give Florida a fighting chance at a better future — and I’m counting on your help to succeed.
[**_Will you pitch in anything you can to our Future of Florida Fund and help me get to work on building a Florida for _all_ Floridians?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54260511/377911543/2140054774?amount=25&refcode=20221107_f_6&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3M2RhM2YzZS1lMTVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YDWSzoBUtlkVbg3lq4vg9Tse0PykuMhq7iypZsLEizM=)

Ron DeSantis is promoting an agenda that will take us backward. He’s signed the most restrictive abortion ban in Florida’s history since _Roe v. Wade_ , championed a “Don’t Say Gay” bill that seeks to bully and further marginalize LGBTQ students, and cracked down on the right to vote.

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Thank you for everything
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=kPdpIHsmuD9glBqiYLNc31eMq3Bp37%2FW&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
Tomorrow, voters head to the polls in our must-win Senate race. All the hard work this team has put in - the dollars donated, the phone calls made, the doors knocked, the signs displayed, the neighbors and friends spoken to - all of it has led to this moment.
**So today, from the bottom of my heart, I want you to say _thank you_. Thank you for everything you've done, Friend. I'm so grateful to have your support. **
We ran a strong, honest campaign. We focused on making progress for the people of this state. My opponent, by contrast, ran a campaign focused on dishonest attacks and courting favor from Donald Trump.
This much is clear: In the Senate, my opponent would be a voice for Trump. I will be a voice for the people of Connecticut - just as I've always been. That's what's at stake in this race.
While everyone in the GOP from Rick Scott to Ronna McDaniel to Trump himself has made this seat a target for defeat, I'm feeling proud of the campaign we ran - and, if everyone gets out and votes, I know that we'll win.
Tomorrow, when we win this race, we will have done our part in protecting a Democratic-controlled Senate that will continue to deliver on the issues that matter to the vast majority of Americans.
It's the honor of my life to serve as Connecticut's U.S. Senator. Thank you again for your support. **And if you haven 't had the chance to yet, get out there and vote - and make sure your friends and family do too!**
Sincerely,
Dick

clean_body: Friend, Tomorrow, voters head to the polls in our must-win Senate race. All the hard work this team has put in - the dollars donated, the phone calls made, the doors knocked, the signs displayed, the neighbors and friends spoken to - all of it has led to this moment. So today, from the bottom of my heart, I want you to say thank you. Thank you for everything you've done, Friend. I'm so grateful to have your support. We ran a strong, honest campaign. We focused on making progress for the people of this state. My opponent, by contrast, ran a campaign focused on dishonest attacks and courting favor from Donald Trump. This much is clear: In the Senate, my opponent would be a voice for Trump. I will be a voice for the people of Connecticut - just as I've always been. That's what's at stake in this race. While everyone in the GOP from Rick Scott to Ronna McDaniel to Trump himself has made this seat a target for defeat, I'm feeling proud of the campaign we ran - and, if everyone gets out and votes, I know that we'll win. Tomorrow, when we win this race, we will have done our part in protecting a Democratic-controlled Senate that will continue to deliver on the issues that matter to the vast majority of Americans. It's the honor of my life to serve as Connecticut's U.S. Senator. Thank you again for your support. And if you haven 't had the chance to yet, get out there and vote - and make sure your friends and family do too! Sincerely, Dick

clean_body: The choice couldn’t be clearer. The stakes couldn’t be higher. I know we can meet the moment. | | Derek, in just a few years, we have made enormous progress. We’ve built an economy that grows from the bottom up and middle out. We’ve passed historic legislation to lower costs -- without a single Republican vote -- and bring down the cost of energy, prescription drugs, health care costs, and so much more. But tomorrow, we’re going to make a choice about whether we go forward or backwards. The power is in your hands. So I’m coming to you as our party makes critical final investments before polls open. Kamala and I are counting on you to make your first contribution of the year before polls open. Will you make a $7 contribution to the DNC today to help fund critical last-minute investments and get out the vote nationwide? With your help, we created 10 million jobs so far. We got the unemployment rate down to 3.5 percent, a 50-year low. What’s the Republican plan? They want to cut Social Security and Medicare -- to the point that they’re willing to shut down the government. Let me be clear: I will not cut Social Security. I will not cut Medicare. The choice couldn’t be clearer. The stakes couldn’t be higher. I know we can meet the moment. I’ve never been more optimistic about America’s future than I am today. Thank you, Derek. Joe Joseph R. body:
My name is Stacey Yvonne Abrams and I’m running to be the next governor of the great state of Georgia.

|
---
The journey to this moment has been a long one, team. But before I tell you more, I need your help in the final stretch of this race. [**Election Day is tomorrow and my team can’t fall short between now and when polls close. Will you split a $30 donation right now between Marcus Flowers and me to help fuel our campaigns? Every vote counts in this election — and so does every contribution.**](https://www.marcusforgeorgia.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzt_D5B92MAm48ES__66FxGamGSIi0T7fVL_m6k3jpH2X6WhKDB9k2mhLGDBv6aSXMA&e=3c0efca69a2e76c4868c82f23dff8b2a&utm_source=marcusflowers&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=221107_abrams1_all&n=1) | [](https://www.marcusforgeorgia.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzt_D5B92MAm48ES__66FxGamGSIi0T7fVL_m6k3jpH2X6WhKDB9k2mhLGDBv6aSXMA&e=3c0efca69a2e76c4868c82f23dff8b2a&utm_source=marcusflowers&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=221107_abrams1_all&n=2 "DONATE NOW >>") [DONATE NOW >>](https://www.marcusforgeorgia.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzt_D5B92MAm48ES__66FxGamGSIi0T7fVL_m6k3jpH2X6WhKDB9k2mhLGDBv6aSXMA&e=3c0efca69a2e76c4868c82f23dff8b2a&utm_source=marcusflowers&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=221107_abrams1_all&n=2)
---
Friend, I began this journey in June 2017, when I stood in Chehaw Park in Albany to announce my candidacy for governor. I ran for 16 months. By the end of the campaign, our team had mobilized the most diverse coalition Georgia had ever seen before.
**Even as the odds mounted against us, and Republicans worked hard to decrease access to voting, we fought to the very end. With hope. With determination.**
But I didn’t get the job in 2018.
But I didn’t quit, I kept working for Georgians. I changed my how but never lost what drives me. And I decided to try again because I know Georgia can be extraordinary if we truly invest in our people. I believe in meeting people where they are, not where you want them to be. I believe that if we want people to turn out, we have to show that it is worth the pain of hope.
**But it’s not about 2018, 2020 or 2021 anymore. This year, we face a once-in-a-generation opportunity to make unprecedented progress both today and tomorrow for our families. We look to the future and imagine the incredible story we can write for ourselves and our families — if we have a governor who sees all of us.**
[**That’s why I know it’s worth it to fight. To try again. To do everything we can to win. So, that’s why I ask, team. clean_body: My name is Stacey Yvonne Abrams and I’m running to be the next governor of the great state of Georgia. | The journey to this moment has been a long one, team. But before I tell you more, I need your help in the final stretch of this race. | "DONATE NOW >>" Friend, I began this journey in June 2017, when I stood in Chehaw Park in Albany to announce my candidacy for governor. I ran for 16 months. By the end of the campaign, our team had mobilized the most diverse coalition Georgia had ever seen before. Even as the odds mounted against us, and Republicans worked hard to decrease access to voting, we fought to the very end. With hope. With determination. But I didn’t get the job in 2018. But I didn’t quit, I kept working for Georgians. I changed my how but never lost what drives me. And I decided to try again because I know Georgia can be extraordinary if we truly invest in our people. I believe in meeting people where they are, not where you want them to be. I believe that if we want people to turn out, we have to show that it is worth the pain of hope. But it’s not about 2018, 2020 or 2021 anymore. This year, we face a once-in-a-generation opportunity to make unprecedented progress both today and tomorrow for our families. We look to the future and imagine the incredible story we can write for ourselves and our families — if we have a governor who sees all of us. body:

---
| |

| |
## Friends,
##
Tomorrow is Election Day! And we need you to stand with us and vote Republican down the ticket. Now is not the time to sit back and see what happens.
---
| |
---
|
## The future of our country depends on your vote. Please do not take it lightly.

If you have already voted, please make sure that your family, friends, and neighbors have as well. The polls look positive for Republicans, but we cannot take it for granted. We must get America back on track and your vote is critical is doing so.

#### VOTE RED tomorrow!
**Sincerely yours,** **Jake Evans
RNLA Georgia Co-Chairman**

New Hampshire Republican State Committee
We Can STOP it TOMORROW!

| Derek --
### The election is tomorrow and there's a lot at stake. The NH Dems recently came out in support of an NH Income and Sales Tax...again.
[](https://nhgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYom_5iV1ML7OCl3CFwBmGbN8VpbX8uCSwVng0pXaveQ5V090UwaiOfNGL0_Uq9-PyQ&e=3b759f8f09083dafc3b676ab7322a136&utm_source=nhgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fundraising_sales_income_tax&n=1)
### The Dems are denying their pro-Income and Sales Tax agenda by calling it a _"tax on paychecks."_ It seems that the Dems think Granite Staters are stupid to believe that's not just another way of saying _"Income Tax."_
### We have to stand up to this. We have today and tomorrow to increase our digital ad efforts to encourage Republicans to get out and vote, but we need your help.
### [Can we count on you to help with a donation of $5, $10, or $20.22?](https://nhgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYom_5iV1ML7OCl3CFwBmGbN8VpbX8uCSwVng0pXaveQ5V090UwaiOfNGL0_Uq9-PyQ&e=3b759f8f09083dafc3b676ab7322a136&utm_source=nhgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fundraising_sales_income_tax&n=2)
### Every last cent donated today and tomorrow will go toward getting Republicans out the door and into voting booths to vote for our NH Republican ticket.
### We know you've been getting asked a lot to donate, but this is because we're doing everything we can to make these victories happen.
### You probably wonder where the money goes when you hit "donate," so here's a breakdown of what we can do with your donation in the next 48 hours:
[](https://nhgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYom_5iV1ML7OCl3CFwBmGbN8VpbX8uCSwVng0pXaveQ5V090UwaiOfNGL0_Uq9-PyQ&e=3b759f8f09083dafc3b676ab7322a136&utm_source=nhgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fundraising_sales_income_tax&n=3)
### When you head to the polls tomorrow, remember that Republicans across NH are fighting for YOU to expand our economy and protect YOU from a Democratic Income and Sales Tax.
### Thank you and make sure to get out and vote tomorrow down the Republican ticket!
### Team NHGOP

Peter - I don't want to go to overtime on Wednesday, November 9th.

**Georgia is one of a handful of states that mandates a runoff election for races where no candidate receives more than 50% of the vote. When I played football, we called that OVERTIME!**

I don't know about you, but I'd rather win this race without a runoff. However, according to a recent FiveThirtyEight forecast, no candidate is above 50%. See below:

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=485a30da1fc549d9ba958931c8d07d8f&_e=ZbC27LklBAxv-9fjlRNKw9lixYebHvBbLas1Ybqq7CX0AuuPNfSI6f-uziPaj7-nJnlORHq9q6ar-Q8kRAqyJwfzWatEYH0wh5-fiTmtErVyXHmipcT4CAHSl0VgAa17Tf9mYMqgPG1eXET_Nyb2K4uVd2yFYj5cb4wMRzz27rJ3F3Ujv9ccQDv1esQVt6evZx4SRS7qbyj6NJjIMLht0Ft7Uxq-tRVzyY-aL9VQ2mX3z6fosejkKc_NoeYBXxGNxnsmTSD_2K1wpmjjVaXVmIZhwPLnHkLdVObOmmYPtIO7ZbHGrOHo1xtXtiTNo-ISy72kwqETwBmkYKQWLpzvLOArjGJmhOj5RrrBNbv7MSyBNCKJY3d3ZEbTOs6LlxMcr3OpJoJNDrEknH3ffuD3Sw%3D%3D)
**I want all of us to enjoy the Thanksgiving holiday without political ads!** Turkey, cranberry sauce, football, and naps are calling our names. However, if we don't win 50% of the votes tomorrow, I'm afraid the campaign will be going strong during Thanksgiving week.

So, in the spirit of putting this Senate campaign to bed successfully tomorrow evening, **[will you chip in $10 today to help us fund our massive Get-Out-The-Vote operation?](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=485a30da1fc549d9ba958931c8d07d8f&_e=ZbC27LklBAxv-9fjlRNKw9lixYebHvBbLas1Ybqq7CX0AuuPNfSI6f-uziPaj7-nJnlORHq9q6ar-Q8kRAqyJwfzWatEYH0wh5-fiTmtErVyXHmipcT4CAHSl0VgAa17Tf9mYMqgPG1eXET_Nyb2K4uVd2yFYj5cb4wMRzz27rJ3F3Ujv9ccQDv1esQVt6evZx4SRS7qbyj6NJjIMLht0Ft7Uxq-tRVzyY-aL9VQ2mX3z6fosejkKc_NoeYBXxGNWY_cdzex3WpO1ek1jq9vae_zZwMu2G7s4Ijv4dtH0F_ESUzaoarTovbxY2JC8ZbEb-FNGaBnK34PRN7Jp3Mn46DTe_LGmLxYDuwOUTR2d0bvz9Jw1Obg9yEbsDerPrf88CV_R0kZd4L7QCmerqt87w%3D%3D)**

The future of reproductive rights, the security of our democracy, the health of our planet, and more are on the ballot this year. In Congress, I've been an advocate for our community's needs, and I have no plans to stop now.

Ahead of tomorrow's election, I need your support. Will you contribute to my campaign to power us to another close election victory? Abigail

Team,
In less than 24 hours, thousands of Michiganders will head to the polls. In MI07, there are 615,014 registered voters, with nearly a third voting absentee. As always, we’re prepared here on Team Slotkin.
We’re true data nerds here, and as such we will be closely watching the numbers as they trickle in from the 7 counties in MI07. We have our station, or “war room” as we call it, all set up and ready to go, take a look:
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221107_1&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221107_1&amount=28]
This is where we will be inputting the results coming out of the district, precinct by precinct, and getting a real time result of turnout, vote share, and whether we’re hitting the numbers we need to win. We know the goals we need to hit in our towns and counties in order to add up to a victory in this Republican-leaning district.
There’s quite a bit that goes into ensuring the next day is as smooth as it can possibly be and into reaching out to every voter that we possibly can. In addition to our war room, we’re still operating our 8 staging locations throughout the 2,813 square miles of this district. Our volunteers, staff, and I will be working until the last second before polls close so if you want to help us run through the tape, chip in below. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221107_1&amount=28]
Thank you for hanging in there with me throughout this insane year – now let’s get this done!

[1]Charles Booker

Peter, I will be a much better Senator for Kentucky than Rand
Paul.

Here’s how I know: In 12 years in the Senate, he’s never passed a bill. He
also refused to debate me. And he closed all but one of his in-state
offices.

Put simply: He doesn’t care about Kentucky. But I do.

ration my insulin because I couldn’t afford the medication I needed as a
Type 1 diabetic.

But with just ONE DAY remaining, I need your help. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18845?t=1001&akid=2740%2E346206%2E_invNg ]So I have to ask:
Will you pitch in $20 or more to help me win tomorrow and defeat Rand
Paul?

DONATE NOW →

My name is Charles Booker. I’m on a mission to defeat Rand Paul and
restore leadership to the Senate and representation for Kentucky, from the
Hood to the Holler.

Thank you,

Charles

name: =?utf-8?Q?Team=20Spartz?=
subject: An Update from the Trail
body:
Just a few days until Election Day! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/spartzforcongress/330sdbyb79-15952956?e=57d5bacdc3)
---
|
---
|
---
# A Message from Victoria Spartz
The election is just days away, and this is without a doubt one of the most important elections of our lifetime. The radical one party Democrat rule in Washington is having disastrous effects on our country and our standing around the world, and we need to send a clear message on Tuesday November 8th, that we have had enough. With your help, we are going to hold on to Indiana’s 5th District with a resounding victory, pick up seats around the country from the local level all the way to the U.S. Senate, and we are going to take the House back and fire Nancy Pelosi!What we have seen over the past two years has caused record spending and inflation, weakening our economy and our national security, and portraying weakness on the global stage. Together, we will fight back and put our country back on the path of greatness. Thank you for your support in our fight!
|
---
# 2022 Woman of Influence
Recently, I was humbled to be named one of the Indianapolis Business Journal’s 2022 Women of Influence honorees. It was a true honor to be included among so many influential women in business, the arts, and community and public service. We each play a role in making central Indiana a better place to live and work, and I’m proud to partner with so many qualified and capable women. Thank you to the IBJ for this award!
|
---
# On the Trail
It is always a pleasure to join my fellow Hoosiers on the campaign trail, and I have enjoyed meeting new friends and old across our district and beyond over the past few weeks. Being in our communities is a refreshing break from Washington D.C., and I’m happy to be home with all of you as much as I can be!
It was a packed house at the Hamilton County Republican Party Fall Dinner. As we head into Election Day, Hoosiers across our state are fired up and ready for huge victories up and down the ballot!
It was a pleasure to join members of the Muncie-Delaware County Chamber of Commerce and talk about our work in Congress to push back against out of control spending and burdensome regulations that are stifling businesses large and small. Together, we will continue to push back and stop killing the American Dream!
Thank you to our volunteers who helped at a very successful Super Saturday event recently. I appreciate everyone who has been getting our message of limited government and fiscal responsibility to every corner of our district and beyond!
I enjoyed a recent event with friends and constituents in Grant County, including my former colleague in the State Senate, Andy Zay. Great coffee and conversation was had!
Finally, I was proud to join other state and local Republican candidates for a stop along the Results Over Rhetoric GOTV Tour! Republicans are ready for big wins on Tuesday!
|
---
# We Need Your Help!
On Tuesday, November 8th, we must ensure every neighbor, friend and family member comes out to vote, and supports our efforts! Indiana will lead a red wave that will sweep across our great nation, but we must VOTE. Please make sure you know where your local polling location is, and remember, polls are open on Tuesday from 6am to 6pm.
| [FIND YOUR POLLING LOCATION HERE](https://spartzforcongress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c85918f147157cf1c0ccdcf91&id=acd81cba4b&e=57d5bacdc3)
---
We also need volunteers to help Team Spartz on Election Day by greeting voters at the polls and showing our support. Can you spare just a couple hours to help? If so, please fill our the form below and we will be in touch!
| [SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER ELECTION DAY](https://spartzforcongress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c85918f147157cf1c0ccdcf91&id=661973b1e9&e=57d5bacdc3)
---
We are in the final stretch and are ready to win BIG on Tuesday. Will you help fuel our last minute efforts with a contribution today? These funds will enable us to reach every voter possible in these critical final days.
| [DONATE TODAY](https://spartzforcongress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c85918f147157cf1c0ccdcf91&id=cfda11744b&e=57d5bacdc3)
---
Thank you for your continued support!-Team Spartz

| **What is on the ballot?**
Following is a summary of the ballot measures that appear on the
November 8, 2022, General Election Ballot.
**_Constitutional Amendment 1_**

This constitutional amendment, if approved by the voters, modifies the powers of the State Treasurer. Specifically, the State Treasurer is required to invest certain state moneys in:

* Missouri banking institutions selected by the State Treasurer and approved by the Governor and State Auditor; or
* Obligations of the United States government or any agency or instrumentality thereof maturing and becoming payable not more than seven years from the date of purchase.

The amendment additionally authorizes the State Treasurer to invest in:

* Municipal securities possessing one of the five highest long term ratings or the highest short term rating issued by a nationally recognized rating agency and maturing and becoming payable not more than five years from the date of purchase; and
* Other reasonable and prudent financial instruments and securities as otherwise provided by law.

**_Constitutional Amendment 3_**

This constitutional amendment makes various modifications to the regulation of marijuana. See the attached summary for a more detailed description.

**_Constitutional Amendment 4_**

Under current law, the General Assembly cannot require a city to increase an activity or service beyond that required by existing law, unless a state appropriation is made to pay the city for any increase costs.

This constitutional amendment, if approved by the voters, provides an exception to allow for a law that increases minimum funding, if increased before December 31, 2026, for a police force established by a state board of police commissioners to ensure they have additional resources to serve their communities.

**_Constitutional Amendment 5_**

This constitutional amendment, if approved by the voters, creates the Missouri Department of the National Guard, which shall consist of the Adjutant General and shall administer the militia, uphold the Constitution of the United States and the Constitution of the state of Missouri, and provide for other defense and security mechanisms.

**_Question on Convening Constitutional Convention_**

Every 20 years, the Missouri Constitution requires a question be submitted to the voters inquiring whether a constitutional convention shall be held for the purpose of revising and amending the state constitution. A "yes" vote would support calling a constitutional convention. A "no" vote would oppose calling a constitutional convention.

| **HELP FOR SMALL BUSINESS AND NON- PROFITS **
The U.S. Small Business Administration approved Missouri’s request for assistance through the federal agency’s disaster loan program. This move makes low-interest disaster loans available to small businesses and private non-profits severely impacted by the Coronavirus (COVID-19).

SBA’s Economic Injury Disaster Loans offer up to $2 million in assistance for each affected small business or non-profit. These loans can provide vital economic support to small businesses to help overcome the temporary loss of revenue they are experiencing.

| | | | |

| | | | | Peter, did you have a chance to take action on this crucial Senate race yet? **_A former Special Forces General turned radical right-wing Senate nominee for the GOP from New Hampshire has a plan to end our democracy._** **_Think I'm being hyperbolic? Don Bolduc, a full-on MAGA-Republican fascist, called on Americans to "rejoice" when Roe V. Wade was overturned, and said he'd fully ban abortion. As Democratic, pro-choice Senator Maggie Hassan--whom we MUST reelect!---put it at the time:_** “He said he would vote for any anti-choice legislation in the U.S. Senate, and that he would never compromise,” **It's chilling.** [**Can you join Blue Amp Action in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Senator Maggie Hassan to protect abortion and voting rights?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3b8708c4-9eac-4881-88c8-cc7c2a9d420e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _But, his position on the U.S. Senate may be even more terrifying. He's quietly, along with right-wing cranks, pushed for the repeal of the 17th Amendment.**The 17th Amendment gave Americans the ability to elect Senators in their states a century ago, because in another period of vast corruption, progressives knew state legislatures--who picked U.S. Senators at the time--were easily bought by big money.**_ So, progressives passed the 17th Amendment. And much like getting rid of Social Security or abortion rights, even talking about repealing the 17th Amendment was a fringe, fever swamp idea for the 20th and early 21st Century. But, now, it's championed by the insane Bolduc, and others. **_It is not hyperbole to say if the 17th Amendment were repealed DEMOCRATS WOULD NEVER AGAIN CONTROL THE U.S. SENATE_. **

name: Catherine Cortez Masto
subject: Thank you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
Hi friend,
I’m reaching out about the most important Senate race in the country, which could decide whether Democrats hold onto and strengthen our majority: my friend Catherine Cortez Masto’s race in Nevada.
Catherine knows a thing or two about making cracks in glass ceilings. Back in 2016, Republicans spent $50 million trying to defeat her. Pundits and pollsters counted Catherine out, predicting Nevada would flip red. But she fought her heart out and overcame it all, becoming our nation’s first and only Latina senator.
History has a way of repeating itself: Catherine once again is facing Republican attacks that media reports have called “unprecedented” – with Mitch McConnell and his allies spending more than $55 million to defeat her. Every major election forecaster – The New York Times , CNN, Nate Silver’s FiveThirtyEight – has called Catherine the most vulnerable senator on the ballot. Experts are saying Nevada is Mitch McConnell’s best hope at flipping a seat red, and he only needs to pick up one seat to take back control of the Senate.
I'm asking you to not let that happen. Catherine needs your grassroots support in these crucial, final days of the election. Will you split a donation of
Across the country, we are seeing a wave of extremist Republican candidates – handpicked and backed by Donald Trump – running to flip the Senate red. Nevada is no exception. Catherine is up against an opponent who led Donald Trump’s efforts to overturn the election results in Nevada. Her opponent also celebrated the overturning of Roe, calling the landmark law that protected reproductive freedom “a joke.”
So, friend, this election is not merely a choice between divergent political parties. It’s a choice of whether we stand with candidates like Catherine on the side of truth, progress and democracy – or whether we allow candidates loyal to Donald Trump take power and trample all over our democracy.
The choice is ours to make, but time is running short. With just five days to go, polling shows Catherine in a statistical tie with her opponent, so she urgently needs grassroots resources to mobilize voters, pull ahead and win. So please, split a contribution of
Thank you,
Hillary Clinton

# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221107-3591-header&t=1&akid=3591%2E2526796%2EKxixEn)
**We’re officially less than 24 hours away from Election Day. And Alexandria is going head to head against a MAGA Republican who’s pulling out all the stops to try and oust our Congresswoman.**
From banners in Yankee Stadium that read “#OustAOC”, to going on Fox to lie about Alexandria – the attacks are ongoing.
**Here’s the truth:** Alexandria has delivered for her district in The Bronx and Queens. She fought for and won billions (with a ‘B’) for Covid-19 funeral assistance after hearing from constituents about the painful economic toll of losing a loved one to Covid. She started an in-district tutoring program to help working parents amid lockdown and beyond, and even tutored a student herself.
Alexandria stood with Starbucks workers as they fought to unionize, and skipped Biden’s inauguration to stand with produce workers in The Bronx who were protesting for living wages. And, she stood with taxi drivers to fight for justice after they were the targets of a predatory loan scheme. The truth is, **Alexandria has always been laser focused on helping the working families of NY-14.**

| Fellow activist,

Remember how Trump was planning to “wage a legal and activist crusade” against our “election integrity” as cover to disenfranchise our voters?

subject: Virginians have been given a challenge
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic Party of Virginia, www
body:
The race to win in Virginia has national consequences

|
---
Derek, Virginia Democrats have been given a challenge: in VA-02 and in VA-07, Congresswoman Luria and Congresswoman Spanberger are running for re-election in two of the closest races in the nation. The results of these elections could decide who holds the Speaker’s gavel in 2023, and whether President Biden will have a Congress that will work with him, or stand against all the progress we’ve made during his time in office. Republican leaders in both chambers have even laid out plans that will go after Medicare and Social Security if they take power. The Democratic Party of Virginia is working every day to ensure Elaine, Abigail, Jennifer Wexton, and the rest of my colleagues over in the House are re-elected on Tuesday. clean_body: | | | | Do you have a plan to vote? | Peter, It is hard to believe that Election Day is tomorrow. Over the past two years, I have traveled our beautiful state, meeting thousands of Alaskans who want the Government to work better for them. For too long, we have not been represented in the Senate by Lisa Murkowski. She campaigns as a Conservative Alaskan, but votes as a DC Liberal. We deserve a Senator that reflects our values. I will always fight for you. I will stop, not enable Joe Biden's radical agenda. I will defend, not infringe the Second Amendment. And I will oppose, not confirm extreme judges that will destroy our liberties. Thank you, Kelly Tshibaka STAY UP TO DATE WITH KELLY AND THE CAMPAIGN BY CLICKING THIS LINK: "ckq.io/yl3xzs" | | | |

_We deserve more than a governor who consistently lies to get her way._ Michelle Lujan Grisham has manipulated our government, lied to our state, and **done everything possible** to take New Mexico down the **wrong path. ** There’s one common trait missing in everything she does as our governor... _**ACCOUNTABILITY.**_

MLG is incapable of holding herself accountable, and the dismal status of our state is what we have to show for it. Utah is DOWN in early ballot returns with just one day left.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

| | Letter from Chairman Eric UnderwoodNov 7, 2022
---
| | In a typical election cycle the question is asked...Who are you going to vote for? Seems like a simple question. It is more of a loaded question, but it is simple. Sometimes, the question is asked “Who should I vote for?” Maybe...the question is asked this way, so an unsure voter can justify or find confidence in their own decision. Or maybe it's asked this way BECAUSE a person has no confidence in their own decision. Or, maybe sometimes people, voters, are just lazy and apathetic, “just give me the answers” mentality. Maybe, they are in a vindictive, vengeful mindset so they say “stick it to” society and simply... don't vote. I wouldn’t recommend that. This mindset is “if they are not a part of voting, they've proven their defiance and disdain for politics in general”. Never mind that the day after the election, they return to being a Keyboard Warrior, the armchair quarterback to the failures of City Hall. Who are you going to vote for?I believe that is NOT the question for this year. With so much at stake and the potential for historic voter engagement in 2023. The real question to answer for yourself is... WHY do you vote? I've asked that very question to 200 Omaha Liberty Ladies. I've asked that question to 40+ Anne Batchelder Republican Women. I asked that question to 25 prominent Republican leaders in Madison County on October 26th. Why do you vote?I asked this question on my Chairman Zoom meetings on Monday nights. The overwhelming responses come back to Patriotic themes – gratitude, service, and honor. As Republicans, the responses are resoundling filled with liberty and resonate the mentality of “It's our civic duty to vote!” especially for those who have fought to keep this American freedom. The veterans will humbly mention, when and how they served this country, but they adamantly declare that they will continue to serve this country even in the simplest of ways by voting and encouraging others to vote. Then the responses turn towards the future. References to “my kids or my grandchildren”, usually bringing about a pause... and reflection. Sometimes they tell a story or describe an inward struggle of “How could we let it get THIS bad in our country?” Usually another pause...but then a firm statement, “I'll be damned if I don't make a stand now for my kids and grandkids”. So I ask all of you to answer this question. Why do you vote? But...don't answer it to me. Answer for yourselves. Answer to your family, answer to your friends and neighbors and co-workers and fellow churchgoers. Tell people why YOU vote, not who you vote for, but WHY. Tell your story and get as many conservative-minded, Constitution following, believers of life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness...get them to VOTE on November 8th. This year has been filled with a fog of veiled truth and unknowns when it comes to Nebraska Republican politics. As I've said in the past, we are modest Republicans just trying to live our lives devoid of politics. However this year, of all the years, has brought more doubt and division to our party as we tried to disseminate the truth and the true character or integrity of the leaders in this party. The Patriot Republicans are divided. Establishment Republicans are divided. Elected officials are divided. All of us share the blame at some level to this division. And the reason is...we've all reached the breaking point. At some level or another we see the liberal agenda squeezing in from the coast, swelling up from the border, and infiltrating our towns and communities. And we want it stopped...YESTERDAY. We are at the extreme state of activism coupled with formal party structure, trying desperately to shield our ‘Good Life’ and our kids from tyranny and a destroyed Nebraska and Country. The time has come for me to be bold. It is time to look in the mirror, call all things like it is, and tackle the solutions head-on...together. First, did you know that 20% of all ballots are already hand-counted because of a write-in component? Think about it. Many races require a write-in for down ballot races, such as in my small town of Malcolm...there will be at least 200 write-in ballots for the school board, in a race with approximately 300+ vote totals. Two-thirds of the ballots will be separated and hand-counted just for Malcolm School Board. How about the arrogant voter that writes their own name for president?Ever seen the jokesters post on Facebook or Twitter, the write-in name of Mickey Mouse for Mayor? There's no NEW forced anomaly by having a Governor's race write-in campaign. Now...the conspiracy theorists seemingly don't trust the people who support the machines, and the past administration who manipulates the machines, but you, the write-in VOTER for Governor, just identified yourselves to them. The conspiracy theorist may say “Who cares if the write-in concept has happened in the past, this way I KNOW that MY ballot is pulled out, hand-counted, and the machine's can't cheat. Of course, that MEANS “they” pulled your ballot for write-in Governor AND ALL your other votes...for school board and County Attorney and legislative district get pulled out too. Personally, I'm not willing to risk my vote for Pat Condon for Lancaster County Attorney, or Mike Foley for State Auditor, or Trevin Preble for Lancaster Public Defender, or Mike Flood for Congress, or Kirk Penner for Board of Education. I wouldn't RISK my Marni Hodgen for Board of Education VOTE, or my Aaron Hanson for Douglas County Sheriff VOTE, or Chris Bruns for LD#42 VOTE, or Kathy Wilmot for Regents. I'm not willing to RISK all my OTHER votes on ONE race if I think my ballot will be flagged now. I'm not willing to sacrifice the GOALS of #36Strong Legislators at the Unicameral, or the goal of FOUR State Board of Education, or ALL the down ballot school boards like Team SET in Elkhorn, or Norris or Millard or Kearney or Scottsbluff. I'm not willing to risk the cutting in half of the [700+ elected Democrats](https://www.ne.gop/so/1eOHG1iJi/c?w=svl1OTis2Zg8d264X7ficsSbNIZLpgG_npUqS_ijHNo.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9uZWJyYXNrYWRlbW9jcmF0cy5vcmcvZWxlY3RlZC1kZW1vY3JhdHMvIiwiciI6ImEwNzU2YjY2LTJjYWMtNGY5ZC04MDM0LWE0ZDgxOGM2NDRhYiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjQxOGMxNzYxLWVkZDMtNGMxYS1iMDY0LWMwYmFjOWQwMjY0ZiJ9) across the state of Nebraska for one race. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54267748/377932616/-744169294?refcode=Header&ms=Header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMTE5MzU3MC1mMTVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-al63tkY1DhX9xIBRP7GefdqUfgyyShEF9jeynZmDMM=&emci=ffdefe20-ef5a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=11193570-f15e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8943725) Peter,

Polling places around Pennsylvania open at 7 a.m. tomorrow, but you don't have to wait to **[look up your polling place and make a plan to vote!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54267749/377932617/-1612268846?source=casey&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMTE5MzU3MC1mMTVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-al63tkY1DhX9xIBRP7GefdqUfgyyShEF9jeynZmDMM=&emci=ffdefe20-ef5a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=11193570-f15e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8943725)**

Each year, many people miss out on their chance to do their part and vote because they don't have a plan before Election Day. If just a few thousand more people in just a few states had planned ahead to vote in 2016, Donald Trump might never have become president.

Today, we face a similar choice about the type of country we want to live in. Fortunately, making a plan to vote is easy. **Just answer these four questions:**
1. **Where will you vote?**
Your polling place may have changed since the last election or if you've moved. **[Be sure to look up your polling place now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54267750/377932618/-1612268846?source=casey&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMTE5MzU3MC1mMTVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-al63tkY1DhX9xIBRP7GefdqUfgyyShEF9jeynZmDMM=&emci=ffdefe20-ef5a-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=11193570-f15e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8943725)**

2. **When will you vote?**
Will you vote this morning before work? Over lunch? After work or school? Deciding now will help you plan ahead.

3. **How will you get there?**
Will you drive to your polling place? Take a walk? Catch a ride from a friend? Or do you need to check a bus schedule?

4. **Who will you bring with you?**
Want to show your kids what voting looks like? Have a neighbor who needs a ride? Bringing someone with you to the polls can help make voting fun, but if you need to find a babysitter, now is the time to decide.

Tomorrow's election will decide whether we keep our Democratic majorities in the House and Senate and continue our progress. By making a plan now, you can ensure your official voting record shows that you made history by being a voter this year.

**Don't miss your chance. Don't wait. Make your plan to vote today.**

We're all counting on you,

Team Casey

Deciding now will help you plan ahead. 3. How will you get there? Will you drive to your polling place? Take a walk? Catch a ride from a friend? Or do you need to check a bus schedule? 4. Who will you bring with you? Want to show your kids what voting looks like? Have a neighbor who needs a ride? Bringing someone with you to the polls can help make voting fun, but if you need to find a babysitter, now is the time to decide. Tomorrow's election will decide whether we keep our Democratic majorities in the House and Senate and continue our progress. By making a plan now, you can ensure your official voting record shows that you made history by being a voter this year. Don't miss your chance. Don't wait. Make your plan to vote today. We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

Our state has been heralded for years as a blue stronghold, but Republicans are investing millions everywhere to flip seats and turn the clock back on all of our hard work. = = Over the past year and a half, Congressional Republicans have made it clear that their values are not in line with those of the American people, but unless we come together, they will continue to push their increasingly extreme agenda with little regard for the impact it has on our citizens. Our campaign still has boots on the ground across the state to activate voters to turn out tomorrow. This is a huge moment for our nation, and we’re pulling out all of the stops to meet voters where they are and connect them to the resources they need to cast their ballot. Delaware's Supreme Court rolled back no-excuse absentee voting, so we are still doing our best to share the news and make sure voters have a plan before Election Day. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | **= | | = | = | | = | = | | = We're not backing down, LBR Congresswoman Lisa Blunt Rochester is a Democrat representing the First State, Delaware. She served as the National Co-Chair of the Biden-Harris campaign and Co-Chair of the DCCC ‘Red to Blue’ program. Lisa is running for reelection to continue fighting for our health care, leading the charge toward environmental justice, and advocating for working families like hers. = Paid for by Lisa Blunt Rochester for Congress Lisa Blunt Rochester for Congress PO BOX 9767 Wilmington, DE 19810 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please . **

name: Ron Johnson
subject: a personal plea
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4iqu2m3tus833n049a8ll0l2rlr7ehgoeu333n8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37chieiqj6d5jmspqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65tj56arr1cbgs5hr5dli66p34pj0cprjcdr16eob2phgehhm4opgeuojcs3imgrrfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup7ephmciqr8pti69j39o5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash1k8gn48n24hhm6pr0slge2oj2c8iv0)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ztaoki6jrn8sefjqkvhqand41910leqmbn6iento_rp22sh2s8i66or7c3im1ob2c9h2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

---
| |

---
|
---
A note from Ron Johnson: America is in peril. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else’s fight, this is our fight, and it’s a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

_**[**Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zm6reok3ejdd546tc7ot1ff3bsp9jsgofla7k3s0_rp22sh2s8i66or7c3im1ob2c9h2bs "Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?")**_

# **Analysis: Despite Dem-Heavy Samples, Laxalt Still Leads**
---
| In the last two weeks, four polls have found Republican Adam Laxalt is leading Democrat Catherine Cortez Masto by at least four points in the Nevada U.S. Senate race. Of these four polls, three sampled more Democrats than Republicans. ** ** All indications point to Laxalt winning independent voters handily and being more competitive among Latino voters than any other Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Nevada in modern history. This is why, even with polls sampling more Democrats than Republicans, Laxalt has a significant lead in this race: [Insider Advantage 550 LVs](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=9dfc37ad1a&e=018ab83301 "https://amgreatness.com/2022/11/05/insideradvantage-poll-republicans-laxalt-and-lombardo-maintain-their-leads-over-democrat-opponents/") – Laxalt lead: 6 points · Conducted Nov 4 · D+5 sample: Dem 36% / GOP 31% / Ind 34% [Susquehanna 500 LVs](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=7df2ea24b5&e=018ab83301 "https://www.busr.ag/nevada-statewide-poll") – Laxalt lead: 6 points · Conducted Oct 24 – 27 · R+1 sample: GOP 36% / Dem 35% / Ind 29% [Emerson 2000 VLVs](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=3b542aa56f&e=018ab83301 "https://emersoncollegepolling.com/nevada-2022-one-week-out-republicans-lead-democrats-for-us-senate-3-of-4-congressional-seats/") – Laxalt lead: 5 points · Conducted Oct 26 – 29 · D+1 sample: Dem 34% / GOP 33% / Ind 33% [Trafalgar 1100 LVs](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=ecfef542dc&e=018ab83301 "https://www.thetrafalgargroup.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/TRF-NV-General-1027-Poll-Report.pdf") – Laxalt lead: 4 points · Conducted Oct 21 – 24 · D+2 sample: Dem 37% / GOP 35% / Ind 28% The bottom line: with the early vote numbers looking anemic for Democrats, Cortez Masto’s operation is going to get increasingly desperate to collect more votes.

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Here’s my closing argument
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
| For the last six years, I’ve been helping to lead the charge to protect our democracy from would-be autocrats. I’ve been helping lead the charge to end gun violence. And I’ve helped lead the charge to fight climate change and get universal healthcare.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=1293%2E5257348%2EpM-I8l)
Derek — it all comes down to Tuesday.
We have all put in the work. We have all knocked doors, made calls, and talked with our families and friends. We have donated and volunteered. We have taken back the House, won the Senate, and defeated Trump.
And yet, on Tuesday, everything we have worked for is at stake. And more than just the House or Senate.
**_Simply put, if Republicans win on Tuesday, we all lose._**
We lose on abortion. We lose on Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid. We lose on drug prices and healthcare. We lose on gun safety.
We lose on climate change. We lose on corporate greed. We lose on personal freedoms. We lose LGBTQ equality. We lose on the economy.
We lose on democracy. And we lose on protecting free and fair elections. Not just in 2024, but potentially for years and years to come.
**It’s worth asking who wins if Republicans win Tuesday. Here’s who wins:**
The wealthiest Americans and largest corporations. The biggest polluters and oil companies. The gun companies.
The most extreme right-wing elements of the MAGA party. Big pharmaceutical companies. And those extremists fighting to take away personal freedoms.
**That’s who will _really_ win if Republicans win on Tuesday. We can’t let that happen. We just can’t.**
That’s why I’m running for reelection. Because our work is not done.
For the last six years, I’ve been helping to lead the charge to protect our democracy from would-be autocrats. I’ve been helping lead the charge to end gun violence. And I’ve helped lead the charge to fight climate change and get universal healthcare.
**_And I’m not done. Far from it._**
I hope that I’ve earned your support. I hope that I’ve earned your vote. And I hope that I’ve earned your trust. Because the next two years will be incredibly tough, and I’m ready for that fight too.

body:
Peter, so much is at stake...
#
Peter, it’s Pramila here...
I needed to make sure you hear how I’m feeling about tomorrow.
**Tomorrow promises to be an election** that could change our country forever. Everyone is facing a choice, and we have to believe voters will make the right one. But we owe it to ourselves to do everything we can until the moment polls close.
**I know that a Democratic majority allows progressives to continue pushing the country forward** on the issues that really matter: reproductive rights, climate action, living wages, immigration reform, labor protections, and so much more.
We’re up against a deadline none of us can ignore – the final and most important one of the past two years. **Our campaign is relying on a groundswell of grassroots donations** to get over the finish line AND bring other progressives with us, so we can grow our collective power in Congress.
[**The final 24 hours will be critical, and we simply must stay strong. That’s why I’m asking: can you chip in $27 or more to support us in our final push?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22614?refcode=em20221107-1817&t=1&akid=1817%2E420207%2EWc7pvR)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22614?refcode=em20221107-1817&t=20&akid=1817%2E420207%2EWc7pvR)**
We cannot drop the ball now. And it’s clear that Democrats are largely being outspent in the most influential election of my whole lifetime.
**Our progressive agenda hinges on the next 24 hours.** And I’m determined to do everything in my power to protect everything we’ve fought so hard for.
But none of us can do it all alone, so I need you to work with me if we’re going to win this election. We’re in this together, and we have to make every single minute count.
[**I believe so strongly in our grassroots movement, and I’m hoping to see our power with the donations we bring in over the next 24 hours. Will you be one of the donors to get us across the finish line when it really matters?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22614?refcode=em20221107-1817&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1817%2E420207%2EWc7pvR)
I KNOW we can do this — thank you for your time and support today,
Pramila
(Sent from my iPhone)

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5af2407090a7481a85836c5b1d2c2ae0&_e=P9YX5OPZlDrJgF0kYaqMdD9TT_jVZhnK_wD7GiZa4wYVMvigS3Y1fTVU7d_xqEAtUbaNmba10maa542y2VO_asIWnBclBwfvOVXiq_BG2ev2t6g682860AxKVyplDqxVkX_yNVnDDFC7p8BTKDFXlnpc8rYSrKbJJlqRK9zq9vhgZi4ozwKU6TMj-vO22I58CdAOIjvCrJa-M4fgE0C9P0zrWLujJxSV_t78IqVJj-4FLllUAjFkdSyAm59-ivkMfggUkwmJe6Q6ci324-UluhM80d3zMy2ny9iGWtD9LywZI-ifzxwC_bgp8Yl_yJZ7RAeQiwhrUxo-arZWwOlY5TtgYfydhaiQyJtiUbF0sFb82u2sK4a3k-25dCnVr2xQpX6hPI90mlC42OAQuWBc4ngM8lX_OcbI1q5XWKA9R3Sc-q0kV_t3lZff8oMbuNYQ "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5af2407090a7481a85836c5b1d2c2ae0&_e=P9YX5OPZlDrJgF0kYaqMdD9TT_jVZhnK_wD7GiZa4wYVMvigS3Y1fTVU7d_xqEAtUbaNmba10maa542y2VO_asIWnBclBwfvOVXiq_BG2ev2t6g682860AxKVyplDqxVkX_yNVnDDFC7p8BTKDFXlnpc8rYSrKbJJlqRK9zq9vhgZi4ozwKU6TMj-vO22I58CdAOIjvCrJa-M4fgE0C9P0zrWLujJxSV_t78IqVJj-4FLllUAjFkdSyAm59-ivkMfggUkwmJe6Q6ci324-UluhM80d3zMy2ny9iGWtD9Lyz1DqPRPRgRBqmMbOrqagWQ3oZx-MNzYUAFYg2TNVgYvnzkEjkMzxLtJ4jnNIr_jwPW0kt4_iK6qzVU9uj24C26KRwgClyAKS86RJ5clft6wt18ESc6kXLz9zOYjg_gcnSc0W5HuwF7U5-wGDJqbjP0 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5af2407090a7481a85836c5b1d2c2ae0&_e=P9YX5OPZlDrJgF0kYaqMdD9TT_jVZhnK_wD7GiZa4wYVMvigS3Y1fTVU7d_xqEAtUbaNmba10maa542y2VO_asIWnBclBwfvOVXiq_BG2ev2t6g682860AxKVyplDqxVkX_yNVnDDFC7p8BTKDFXlnpc8rYSrKbJJlqRK9zq9vhgZi4ozwKU6TMj-vO22I58CdAOIjvCrJa-M4fgE0C9P0zrWLujJxSV_t78IqVJj-4FLllUAjFkdSyAm59-ivkMfggUkwmJe6Q6ci324-UluhM80d3zMy2ny9iGWtD9LyystZqU3VHKSdcnrI8jdYX572nbt9X5cZHXRRutr2t2bFKBlGtinnHmR6f9F03feBqcbUdngYJRtIterrLzwQDWertCCizTbqjqZIUxZUw6H4QOqL32YmJ638lTP6jzvWxNacDwb1NDsPSDjiAS0ju9 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5af2407090a7481a85836c5b1d2c2ae0&_e=P9YX5OPZlDrJgF0kYaqMdD9TT_jVZhnK_wD7GiZa4wYVMvigS3Y1fTVU7d_xqEAtUbaNmba10maa542y2VO_asIWnBclBwfvOVXiq_BG2ev2t6g682860AxKVyplDqxVkX_yNVnDDFC7p8BTKDFXlnpc8rYSrKbJJlqRK9zq9vhgZi4ozwKU6TMj-vO22I58CdAOIjvCrJa-M4fgE0C9P0zrWLujJxSV_t78IqVJj-4FLllUAjFkdSyAm59-ivkMfggUkwmJe6Q6ci324-UluhM80d3zMy2ny9iGWtD9LyzWJJjYkbL8o3B14fB-Ie1H8_UM7ZM2PjSdTxSJSK9AJeOWRv7WS1UbT9wPSJPge4pQLwkKp7BOrUSoAG29Pb7myz8kx0g0zTI0xnnDPq7Q9eJOs2x53CaJBdfEpIa38mp4xqqUUrXCYFM-mIEDevcR "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5af2407090a7481a85836c5b1d2c2ae0&_e=P9YX5OPZlDrJgF0kYaqMdD9TT_jVZhnK_wD7GiZa4wYVMvigS3Y1fTVU7d_xqEAtUbaNmba10maa542y2VO_asIWnBclBwfvOVXiq_BG2ev2t6g682860AxKVyplDqxVkX_yNVnDDFC7p8BTKDFXlnpc8rYSrKbJJlqRK9zq9vhgZi4ozwKU6TMj-vO22I58CdAOIjvCrJa-M4fgE0C9P0zrWLujJxSV_t78IqVJj-4FLllUAjFkdSyAm59-ivkMfggUkwmJe6Q6ci324-UluhM80d3zMy2ny9iGWtD9LyyQ1CjwETvAuOdSKuFGbpqMoJd19oFmOs5KcxsOsLyYK9cXV3veolw8Emgt-zgwmdkE7St8GfsAz1l_ZVTVifoinvBWVW1joyGYfGR_60JKaGtR4yXKdQGhuq1MACx80uxosWNbNnu-03iuvVWFw8Ud "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5af2407090a7481a85836c5b1d2c2ae0&_e=P9YX5OPZlDrJgF0kYaqMdD9TT_jVZhnK_wD7GiZa4wYVMvigS3Y1fTVU7d_xqEAtUbaNmba10maa542y2VO_asIWnBclBwfvOVXiq_BG2ev2t6g682860AxKVyplDqxVkX_yNVnDDFC7p8BTKDFXlnpc8rYSrKbJJlqRK9zq9vhgZi4ozwKU6TMj-vO22I58CdAOIjvCrJa-M4fgE0C9P0zrWLujJxSV_t78IqVJj-4FLllUAjFkdSyAm59-ivkMfggUkwmJe6Q6ci324-UluhM80d3zMy2ny9iGWtD9LyzU-GfZSRQpJ0cF9eQyA50LzxF29T3HRdU4Z98nBGHSamljeuN4l6MW5WzGcsFEBJQPQpZW2pLEvnkkWLxUQ8pKAyAoj_4Hz5k3kY-GKKlCD182JTNcSUXf88hKMTP_R0xsPb0a_8M_aJgPXTkyJBnw "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5af2407090a7481a85836c5b1d2c2ae0&_e=P9YX5OPZlDrJgF0kYaqMdD9TT_jVZhnK_wD7GiZa4wYVMvigS3Y1fTVU7d_xqEAtUbaNmba10maa542y2VO_asIWnBclBwfvOVXiq_BG2ev2t6g682860AxKVyplDqxVkX_yNVnDDFC7p8BTKDFXlnpc8rYSrKbJJlqRK9zq9vhgZi4ozwKU6TMj-vO22I58CdAOIjvCrJa-M4fgE0C9P0zrWLujJxSV_t78IqVJj-4FLllUAjFkdSyAm59-ivkMfggUkwmJe6Q6ci324-UluhM80d3zMy2ny9iGWtD9LyxHx64DGpHaVnk3MAoPsM8o2GzjlGgKZxIw15QinQ3S-TGNiGKpIkOdKlrnG4LJjdeby5rfsdu9aPjTsOyHNpfB5yudb4u4Wrvu0wl78vdNzjQRRaTAfgsMMrVf1O6BdW6FuUbsAvUAT-ESFuAMWfXe "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5af2407090a7481a85836c5b1d2c2ae0&_e=P9YX5OPZlDrJgF0kYaqMdD9TT_jVZhnK_wD7GiZa4wYVMvigS3Y1fTVU7d_xqEAtUbaNmba10maa542y2VO_asIWnBclBwfvOVXiq_BG2ev2t6g682860AxKVyplDqxVkX_yNVnDDFC7p8BTKDFXlnpc8rYSrKbJJlqRK9zq9vhgZi4ozwKU6TMj-vO22I58CdAOIjvCrJa-M4fgE0C9P0zrWLujJxSV_t78IqVJj-4FLllUAjFkdSyAm59-ivkMfggUkwmJe6Q6ci324-UluhM80d3zMy2ny9iGWtD9LyxiU_f1TLoEAgzANHYpPlahuB_QhhwAj__kb2milmGYAi8W-DK3hvMxm9vgtn6628v_2aFn9RD2V80zBaNUKbqMdBjL-hz8ZaJhnh8ubF9K-Vd7O25vdVYFKZKZoTD2DBi8E8COFVsV5b_cd3hMeTE9 "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

Here’s a link you can use: [**actblue.com/donate/bennet-eday-fund**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54270222/377946564/-690771692?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221107_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMjlkZWJjYi1mOTVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YPghBdYLJBTP0Cc22oU5i9VxX80vvR9tAglYriKrZ_M=) From campaign literature, to tables and clipboards, to snacks and technology for organizing, grassroots support funds the many things that go into running a volunteer program this large. Your donation will help ensure our volunteers want for nothing as they knock doors across Colorado today and tomorrow. **Here’s the link to support our outreach again:[https://actblue.com/donate/bennet-eday-fund](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54270223/377946565/-690771692?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221107_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMjlkZWJjYi1mOTVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YPghBdYLJBTP0Cc22oU5i9VxX80vvR9tAglYriKrZ_M=)** Thanks for all you do to support Michael and our team. We’ll finish this campaign strong because of you. Thanks, Justin Lamorte
Campaign Manager

* * *
There are still thousands of Democratic voters who haven’t returned their ballots yet. They could easily be the difference between a blue Senate and a McConnell majority, so we’re deploying our most committed Colorado supporters to give them a friendly push toward their drop box or polling place.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54236178/377877177/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4860-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ODZlNzA2Mi1jZTVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KWfNZZfJyd7OwMmIEY-liy_ucECm48TvI3vGYgr8scA=)
Friend – you know all too well what tomorrow brings. You know the stakes. You know all that's on the line for our country. But before we get to that, I have two sincere words for you, from the bottom of my heart: **Thank you.**
This movement we've built – it's all because of you, friend.

That we defied the odds to flip Georgia blue in the first place; that we elected a Black man whose mother who used to pick somebody else's cotton; that we sent someone to fight for our progressive values to the Senate – **it's all because of you.**
It's why I'm now counting on you to defend what we've fought for and won – to defend our Senate majority and our very democracy.

**Tomorrow, whether we win or lose in Georgia will determine whether Democrats hold the Senate. With the polls locked in a dead heat and Mitch McConnell's super PAC money still flowing into Georgia to defeat me, we cannot let up even for a second. We must keep up the fight,_keep the faith_ , and get our people-powered message out to more Georgians.**
**[So please, friend, to continue building on what we started – to win in Georgia and defend our Senate majority – will you rush a donation of $5 or more right away? Help protect Georgia’s Senate seat and elect Democrats up and down the ballot nationwide. | | I have been preaching the same message in office that I had been preaching for years at the Ebenezer Baptist Church in Atlanta, where Martin Luther King Jr.'s legacy still runs deep: We can accomplish anything if we come together and have faith in one another. And I’ve got all the faith in the world that we can defend this seat and our Democratic Senate majority -- but only if everyone on this grassroots team does their part to support the crucial organizing work we need to win. Election Day is tomorrow , and many Georgians have already cast their ballots, so I need to place my faith in you again: Will you split a $10 contribution between my reelection campaign and the DNC before polls close tomorrow to support Democrats nationwide? Control of the Senate could very well come down to Georgia, and your support right now is absolutely vital. I've been reflecting on this people-powered movement, and everything we've accomplished, and I am filled with immense gratitude. Together, we defied all odds when we flipped this seat last year -- not only delivering Democrats our Senate majority, but also making history by electing me as the first Black senator to represent Georgia. In the time since, it has been the honor of my life to build a better, brighter future for our children. But our critical fights for justice aren't over, and I'm once again counting on grassroots supporters like you to power this movement to victory before tomorrow: ** It's an honor to fight for you and beside you. We can’t give up now.
