| Like you, I’m beyond tired of the negative ads on television and the Internet, spreading lies and demeaning my 20-year record as a tough, fair, and unbiased judge in Montana. Most Montanans have figured out these lies have no place in Montana or the United States of America.Sadly, over $1million of out-of-state dark money from corporate lobbyists and politicians are funding the false negative ads against me. They are desperately trying to buy a seat on the Montana Supreme Court. Montanans are smarter than these lobbyists and politicians think.The past several months, I’ve waged a positive campaign to help educate voters and encourage them to re-elect me to continue to serve you on the Montana Supreme Court. Please watch my voter education videos at [www.gustafsonformontana.com](https://mgcp01.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=636959eb340ed42009681657&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.gustafsonformontana.com%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D631b8f42dfa36d10a42534cf%26ss_email_id%3D636959eb340ed42009681657%26ss_campaign_name%3DPlease%2Bsupport%2Bmy%2Bpositive%2Bcampaign%2Bto%2Bprotect%2Bthe%2Brights%2Bof%2BMontanans%2B%25E2%2580%25A6%2B%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2022-11-07T19%253A18%253A49Z&w=6179d71408f9587afc0cb8be&l=en-US&s=D76EGE1rnfYUp3R_Zr-5rRNlmBI%3D).Now I need your support.Let’s keep dark money politics out of our courtrooms. Please vote to re-elect me – an independent, experienced Montana judge to the Montana Supreme Court. If you have already voted, please encourage others in your community and throughout Montana to do so.\- **Ingrid Gustafson, Montana Supreme Court Justice** PS: Bring your absentee ballots to your county courthouse please. It’s too late to rely on the mail to get your ballot there in time. Also, if you vote on election day at the ballot box, please plan ahead to be sure you have time to wait in a line just in case it takes longer to vote than you may anticipate. Most important - VOTE! And be sure your friends, neighbors and co-workers do too.

Peter, here’s a quick reminder for you: tomorrow is the last day to vote!

Drop your ballot in the mail, or find a drop box near you. No stamp is needed!

Thanks for everything,

| | | | | **Cliff’s Note:** **Per _CBS News_ polling, "If November’s election sees a big turnout of young voters and voters of color...the Battleground Tracker predicts Democrats hold onto the majority by a single seat..." If not, we lose 10-15 seats, and the House, where Marjorie Taylor Greene will promptly push for Joe Biden's impeachment. _We can't let this happen_. Like the Kansas abortion referendum, younger voters will determine if it does. Please keep this in mind as you read Mark Hamill's urgent plea below to support _Voters of Tomorrow_ , as they register every last voter in states like Colorado--where Lauren Boebert's in danger of losing her seat--that allow voter registration through Election Day.** [**Our Blue Amp community has raised over $10,000 to support Voters of Tomorrow already, and we're so grateful for your faith in the next generation of voters!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T012220c9-73e2-4eed-be9b-450982a159fa/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T10dd6b0e-c1f8-4a02-bdec-bf0bb358a540/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Dear Peter, **Voters of Tomorrow, has a simple plan: Educate, register, and mobilize young voters so they can have a voice in the next election. Younger voters HAVE ALREADY MADE THE DIFFERENCE THIS ELECTION. The record-breaking turnout among younger voters and women in Kansas is credited with destroying a Death Star in Kansas, the referendum attempting to ban all abortion. With its defeat by a whopping 18%, I think we can successfully say that Death Star was destroyed.** **_But if we know anything about Death Stars--and the Right Wing in this country--they're always building more._** I'm not saying any of this to be dramatic, I save that for onscreen. This is for real. They're trying to take away our rights--to choose, whom to love, what books our kids read, the safety of our children inside schools and outside in our climate--RIGHT NOW. Without high turnout from young voters, the fate of our future will be sealed. **_So with the 2022 midterm election only one day away, Voters of Tomorrow's voter registration efforts are more important than ever. They will register every last voter, which in some states continues right up through Election Day._** Registering one new voter costs $4.38, and they're still hoping to register more than 5,000 new voters by the election - that’s $21,900! [**So today, I'm asking you to chip in $22 to help fund their General Election Fund so they can ramp up voter registration efforts. Can you rush a donation right now?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8d93dfc8-c552-47f7-a49b-81e6bb478b52/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **A $22 donation = FIVE new voters registered! $44 and they can register TEN NEW VOTERS! It is time for a reckoning: The cries have started to filter out from the left regarding amnesty for government overreach and the curtailment of our rights during the pandemic. Emily Oster, a Brown University economist, advocates for a Covid Amnesty . Her argument amounts to, "We didn't know what we were doing so let us off the hook." The data is in: The situation regarding the Democrat policy of school closures is summed up best by one of their own. I believe the school closures were a mistake, not only because of their direct effects on achievement but also because of the message they’ve sent about the blue cities and states where closures were concentrated. With little evidence that school closures saved lives and ample evidence that they hurt kids, this is a policy that failed. To make government work better next time, we have to see reality clearly." clean_body: I want all of us to enjoy the Thanksgiving holiday without political ads! | Fellow American - I don't want to go to overtime on Wednesday, November 9th. Georgia is one of a handful of states that mandates a runoff election for races where no candidate receives more than 50% of the vote. When I played football, we called that OVERTIME! I don't know about you, but I'd rather win this race without a runoff. However, according to a recent FiveThirtyEight forecast, no candidate is above 50%. See below: I want all of us to enjoy the Thanksgiving holiday without political ads! Turkey, cranberry sauce, football, and naps are calling our names. However, if we don't win 50% of the votes tomorrow, I'm afraid the campaign will be going strong during Thanksgiving week. So, in the spirit of putting this Senate campaign to bed successfully tomorrow evening, Early voting has finished in Georgia, so now we focus on turning out supporters on Election Day. | | Friend, Before you head to the polls, I wanted to send you one quick email. Tomorrow is Election Day. I have had the honor of serving you in Congress and truthfully, friend, I have never seen a more important election than this year. Hello everyone,
My husband Michael and I had the privilege of serving our nation together for almost three decades.
Different schools, new doctors, different commute, pack up and unpack, good-byes to old friends and hellos to new neighbors — we moved from state-to-state and overseas. I didn’t know married life to a naval officer would be so busy or so enriching when we married in 1989. (Yes, I would do it over again!)
As a family, we were better for it. Our children saw many new schools, sometimes as many as three in a single year, and they were accepting of those disruptions to their lives. Deployments were made more tolerable when email came along, but Michael’s absence was always felt around the dinner table, on holidays, and during family events.
**No challenge we faced these last three decades, though, compares to the demands of running for the U.S. Senate.** Yet this is exactly why my husband is undertaking this next level of service — because he has consistently made the impossible look doable and the difficult look commonplace. Hello Peter **Election Day is tomorrow, and I need you to show up and vote Reed Olson for District 2A**. WEATHER ALERT—> the weather reports are suggesting maybe today is a better day to place your vote. Thankfully, you can vote today in the county elections office! There are a few hours left before they close and the rain starts tonight.
* [Find your polling place](https://votereedolson.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f55dc7af213002cce7e62bd8&id=4a6ef8c234&e=0ba866af2d) for Election Day voting tomorrow, November 8th.
* **Drop off your ballot** if you haven’t already.

Need to register on Election Day?
**You can register to vote at your polling place on Election Day**. Find out what you’ll need to bring with you [here](https://votereedolson.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f55dc7af213002cce7e62bd8&id=9425222602&e=0ba866af2d). Don’t have an ID?
**You can still vote if you don’t have an ID**. Bring a neighbor or friend who lives in your precinct and is a registered voter and can confirm your name and address.Need to take time off work?
**You can take time off work to vote tomorrow.** [You have a right to take time off work to vote](https://votereedolson.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f55dc7af213002cce7e62bd8&id=f1c157b0ca&e=0ba866af2d) without losing your pay, personal leave, or vacation time. Getting involved in this election is the only way to ensure our voices are heard across the state.Thank you so much for your support. Reed Olson

So, I just got the final sign-off to activate the BIGGEST donor impact our campaign has ever offered. Your donation right now could be the DEFINING IMPACT to help us win on Tuesday. | This opportunity is fleeting, and it is the last one before the MIDTERM ELECTION! I hope I’ve earned your support | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/e4c9a25511f9/i-am-running-for-congress-9206758?e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=4688d25f39&e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | Hi there,

**Well, folks, tomorrow is the day — Election Day**. I set out over a year ago to challenge Scott Fitzgerald, fight for American families, and bring common-sense leadership to Washington D.C.

Throughout the campaign I’ve had the privilege of meeting and listening to folks all over the district about what they expect of their Congressman, their hopes for the future of our state and country, and their frustrations with current leadership. I wanted to run this campaign like I believe a member of congress should run their office, by actually going to the people, listening to their thoughts and concerns, and then responding.

**Scott Fitzgerald has shown us time and again that the LAST thing he cares about is American families or what their hopes or concerns may be. He will choose his party and the special interests lining his pockets _every single time._**

When it comes to addressing the real, kitchen table issues affecting all of us here at home, Scott Fitzgerald is nowhere to be found.**We cannot continue to tolerate this behavior — we can replace him by[voting Mike Van Someren for Congress at the polls tomorrow.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=c08b078ae6&e=356c0699dd) **
---
| [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=b783d15ad6&e=356c0699dd)
---
| [PLAN TO VOTE](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=2b6131cd74&e=356c0699dd "PLAN TO VOTE")
---
| Scott Fitzgerald and his party thrive on our division, but we are more alike than we are different. We all want better for our families, and I believe that starts with:
* Restoring our Democracy
* Restoring public safety
* Rebuilding the middle class
* Protecting Roe and our right to privacy
* Prioritizing environmental stewardship

**I’m running for Congress to fight for the foundation of our country.** I’m running because we deserve a representative who will put in the work of listening and helping solve problems faced by our country — not contribute even more to the extreme polarization that’s already paralyzed our government.

**Scott Fitzgerald has been the opposite of all of those things. The 5th Congressional District — and Wisconsin as a whole — deserves better.**

[If I can earn your vote at the polls tomorrow, November 8](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=196b8621ac&e=356c0699dd), we will be one step closer to fixing the broken system in Washington for good.

I’m so proud to be on this journey with you. Thank you.

Mike Van Someren

body:
#
Friends -
Wednesday morning — just about 36 hours from now — we will wake up likely knowing the results of this race.
We’ll know whether we did enough to elect Mandela and send a champion for ALL of Wisconsin to the Senate, or if the millions of dollars worth of super PAC-funded attack ads were enough to drown us out.
And what we **don’t** want to do is wake up worrying that we could’ve done more. Would one more phone call or conversation with a voter have made the difference?
Instead of worrying, let’s leave nothing to chance. Let’s make sure we’ve reached every last voter possible. **So we’re asking for your support again today:**
[**Can you please make a $3 donation to Mandela Barnes to help finish this race strong? Every dollar will go right to reaching voters and boosting turnout in the final push before polls close tomorrow night.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221107-3-tt&t=1&akid=4053%2E196590%2Eqrq8OE)
Unlike Ron Johnson, Mandela isn’t taking a DIME from corporate PACs, and he doesn’t have billionaire mega-donors bankrolling this campaign.
Instead, we run this campaign by relying on lots and lots of people chipping in $3 at a time.
We’re incredibly proud of that fact, but it does mean that we have to ask for your support once again before Election Day.
[**Can you please make a contribution to Mandela Barnes today? We’re counting on a LOT of grassroots donations today to fund our GOTV programs in the final stretch.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221107-3-tt&t=2&akid=4053%2E196590%2Eqrq8OE)
Together, we are going to flip Wisconsin’s Senate seat and expand the Democratic majority. Thank you for being a part of it.
\- Team Mandela

| | Hi Peter, This is Julie Jacobs, Matt’s wife, writing one final time before tomorrow’s election. I love my husband. He’s a good and honest man – and an amazing father. He wants to serve for all the right reasons. Because he loves our community and country. **Because he knows we’re headed in the wrong direction,** **and he wants to get us back on track. ** It’s been painful to see all the false attack ads against him. It’s hard explaining to our kids why people are saying such awful and untrue things about their dad. But Matt hasn’t let the negativity get to him. **He’s still the same “happy warrior” he was on Day One of this campaign.** Every day, Matt goes out and talks to voters with a smile on his face and joy in his heart. Because he believes our country’s best days are still to come. And I believe him. **Families in our community – and across the nation – are suffering.** Record-high inflation, soaring gas and food prices, and skyrocketing crime have made life worse for so many. Matt’s positive, commonsense message has resonated with voters all across the political spectrum. That’s why Matt is **TIED** in the polls right now (in a district President Biden won by over 15 points). That’s why national media – NBC News, the LA Times, the Wall Street Journal, and others – are saying that this is one of **the most competitive races in America.** **Tomorrow, everything comes down to** **YOU.** Tomorrow, you have the chance to cast your ballot for a man who will help chart a new and better course for our country – a Congressman we can all be proud of. If you haven’t already made a plan to vote tomorrow, please do so now by [finding your polling location here](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=d7ada2079ad64d28ad366d5dfff6ec3e&_e=GwQSzBZcKPC9R4_YJBZWu8WV4uhWuNpTU3CZ34KHGFc-bOC3M2d290Arqj-NqsNnIOljlhfhNooOlwAIM2iFBXIoLK7nIAwqS06j83DycsyvQAICf2L7jgJ_z74PDhEMoO9h7tFANs2ZFaOq86DpypZUpH-mOaWqeAzyPH7QKBKcUJ-cfMnWCZcIf1GsFHo7noDNtjcABqRabpWwm7sAodm0z93bTbaFxPut2ByK6Po%3D). #### Announcement
**From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq** Dear Hoosiers, it's been 1,041 days since I started my campaign for U.S. Senate. Whew! What an amazing journey. As you know, it hasn't been easy and we haven't always agreed on everything, but you stuck around because you believed in someone who truly wanted to make a difference for Indiana.

**No matter how things turn out tomorrow night, I'll be continuing my political commentary via social media and by newsletter so be sure to stay subscribed and stay tuned because there's much more to come! **

In the meantime, know that I appreciate you and that I couldn't have done any of it without you! Thank you from the bottom of my heart. Now, no matter what side of the political aisle you're on...it's time to go vote! Go and make your voices heard. Happy Voting!
**Now, here's what I need you to do right now: **
* Share this message with nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform that it's time to fulfill their civic duty!
* [Subscribe and follow me on social media](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=07cdf15219&e=a49cb82bb3) where I'm active and live often. Share a post or two!

Visit [haneefahkhaaliq.org](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=ddb5e30c16&e=a49cb82bb3) and view my 33 national policies and agendas! I am Indiana. You are Indiana. Together, we are Indiana!

Sincerely,
Haneefah Khaaliq, Esq.
Indiana Candidate for U.S. Senate

body:
I’m running for re-election to keep fighting to make our country stronger, and we have a lot of work to do... | | |
---
| |
---
| Dear Kansans,

I like to think of the Big First District as the pilot light of America because the values that make America great are still alive and well here. We strive to live our lives by faith, family, hard work, and personal responsibility.

I spent my first term in Congress advocating for agriculture and our Kansas conservative values. I stood up for the right to life and used my vote on the House Floor to protect our Second Amendment rights at every opportunity. I voted against big government socialism, wasting tax payer dollars, open borders, and federal government overreach.

I’m running for re-election to keep fighting to make our country stronger, and we have a lot of work to do. We need to curb inflation, fix our struggling supply chain, secure our southern border, lower taxes, and get input costs on the farm back down to normal. We need to get our whole country back on track.

If you want a fifth-generation Kansan who understands our values, our struggles, and our way of life representing you in Washington, D.C., then please vote for me on November 8th.

**_And if you want to take our country back and protect our freedoms, vote Republican down the ticket, and vote for Derek Schmidt for Governor. Thank you for giving me the privilege of serving you. _**

God bless Kansas, and God bless America.

Rep. Tracey Mann

P.S. I will continue to stand for Kansas as we move forward, and I will do everything in my power to ensure that our kids have a bright future. | Friend,

It’s being reported that former New York City Mayor Mike Bloomberg is set to cut a $10 million check to Democrats hoping to keep their Congressional majorities.

No matter what way you look, that is a heck of a lot of money, first name Think about how far these dollars could go in places like New Hampshire, Nevada, and Wisconsin..

body:
| Peter,

When I kicked off this campaign, I promised this team and North Carolina that we would work harder than we ever have to turn our state blue.

I don’t want any of us to wake up on November 9 with regrets. We need to know we gave it our all, made the best decisions possible with the information and resources at hand, and that we had nothing more we could have invested.

You may ask why I feel so strongly about this, and the truth is that my race for Chief Justice in 2020 was ultimately decided by 401 votes — out of over 5 million.

Yes, that’s just how close these races in North Carolina can be, but I sometimes wonder if there was more we could’ve done.

And now there’s a real chance that this Senate race comes down to a similar margin on Tuesday. Frankly, I can’t remember the last poll that didn’t show our campaign statistically tied.

So when the days feel long or the challenges feel steep, I think about those 401 votes. And I remind myself of the promise we made to work as hard as we possibly can. I will do everything I can today, right now, to make sure that we flip this seat.

I’m so grateful for everyone who has pitched in their time and talent already.

clean_body: | Peter, When I kicked off this campaign, I promised this team and North Carolina that we would work harder than we ever have to turn our state blue. I don’t want any of us to wake up on November 9 with regrets. We need to know we gave it our all, made the best decisions possible with the information and resources at hand, and that we had nothing more we could have invested. You may ask why I feel so strongly about this, and the truth is that my race for Chief Justice in 2020 was ultimately decided by 401 votes — out of over 5 million. Yes, that’s just how close these races in North Carolina can be, but I sometimes wonder if there was more we could’ve done. And now there’s a real chance that this Senate race comes down to a similar margin on Tuesday. Frankly, I can’t remember the last poll that didn’t show our campaign statistically tied. So when the days feel long or the challenges feel steep, I think about those 401 votes. And I remind myself of the promise we made to work as hard as we possibly can. I will do everything I can today, right now, to make sure that we flip this seat. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elaine for Congress
body:
---
| | Team, in just 12 hours, tens of thousands of Coastal Virginians will cast their ballots in this battleground race and decide the future of our district. In these final days, I’ve thought a lot about this campaign. I’m lucky to have some of the most incredible staff and most generous supporters around, and that’s made this race the most rewarding one of my career yet. I won’t lie though, this has been an uphill battle – we’ve been running a full throttle campaign in one of the most competitive and expensive House districts in the nation for more than a year. name: Joe Biden
subject: Derek, I am humbly requesting one final time.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic National Committee, **[www
body:
Our party needs to rush more resources to the front lines in important battleground states where races up and down the ballot are still too close for comfort. | |
---
Derek, this election is a choice between two vastly different visions for America:
* Democrats are building an economy that grows from the bottom up and the middle out. Republicans are doubling down on their mega MAGA trickle-down economics that benefits the very wealthy. **It failed the country before and will fail us again.**

* Democrats are going to protect Social Security and Medicare. Republicans have stated boldly that they want to cut Social Security and Medicare.

* Republicans want to pass a national ban on abortion. If we elect more Senate Democrats and keep control of the House, we’re going to codify _Roe v. Wade._

Now, with so much at stake, our party needs to rush more resources to the front lines in important battleground states where races up and down the ballot are still too close for comfort. Hey Peter, Tomorrow is Election Day, so I wanted to take a moment and give you one final update before the big day. **But most importantly, I’m writing to say thank you.** We’ve accomplished so much over the past year, and this campaign would not have been possible without your support. Whether you contributed, volunteered, or even just told a friend or neighbor about our campaign – it adds up to a winning effort. I’m humbled to have you on this team. I made the decision to run for Congress because I love this country, and I believe that we need a new generation of leaders who will put politics aside to protect our democracy and deliver for the American people. Right now, we’re confronting a brand of political extremism that benefits from division and distrust in our institutions. If it’s not defeated, its adherents will rip away our rights piece by piece, and if we’re going to get our government working again, it starts by ousting guys like Ken Calvert. This race has always been about holding the corrupt accountable and stopping extremism so we can get to work for you, the people. body:
| Peter, Before the polls open tomorrow morning, I wanted to take a moment to extend my sincere gratitude to all of you for being a part of our campaign. We’ve accomplished so much, and none of it would have been possible without your support. This race has always been personal for me: I was born and raised in this district. I served the residents of IL-17 as a meteorologist for years, helping everyday people prepare for their days. Because my roots here are so deep, I’m intimately familiar with the problems that the residents of Northwest and Central Illinois are facing – from skyrocketing healthcare costs to reproductive freedoms coming under threat. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Jen Jordan, Inc
body:
Friend, it's hard to believe we're almost at the end of this campaign — and I'm determined to make every remaining hour count.

[**If we raise $2,682 more tonight, we'll enter tomorrow in a strong position when the polls open. Can you pitch in $10 or more to help us fight for every last vote?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54268642/377936218/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_221107ED4_N_JJ_FULL_6_NG_N_L1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzcyMTgxZC1mNDVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jB5fQWJEYl_TE-wPozBITD_dyVITN1pN-i-g358nYtQ=)

Talking to voters throughout Georgia for the last 19 months has shown me that we're experiencing a moment of monumental political change. Georgians want an end to the dangerous election lies, they want leaders who will take a stand for transparency and ethics, and they want to restore a woman's right to choose.

I'm running to use the law as a tool for justice– to hold special interests accountable, protect reproductive freedom, root out injustice and discrimination wherever it exists, and preserve our democracy. This campaign has been about giving voice to those without power, those who've been ignored, and those who just need a fair shot to get ahead.

We've accomplished so much in this campaign and engaged so many Georgians in critical conversations about how Attorneys General directly affect their lives. But now, all our hard work is about to be put to the test. We need one final push to achieve a historic victory.

**So one last time, I'm asking for your support. If you can, please make a donation here:** [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jenjordan_em**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54268644/377936220/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_221107ED4_N_JJ_FULL_6_NG_N_L2&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YzcyMTgxZC1mNDVlLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jB5fQWJEYl_TE-wPozBITD_dyVITN1pN-i-g358nYtQ=)

Jen

clean_body: | | Friend, I’m writing today on behalf of my daughter, Brenda Siegel. Tomorrow, my daughter will be on the ballot as the Democratic nominee for Vermont Governor. She is one day away from becoming Governor of Vermont. I am immensely proud of what Brenda’s accomplished, but I’m not surprised. I’ve watched Brenda grow up and become a tireless advocate for what’s right, fighting for people all across the state and country. Brenda is and always has been a fighter for the people. She’s never cared about where you come from or what you believe; all that matters to Brenda is helping people. She will do whatever it takes to fight for the rights of others. With less than 24 hours until polls close, it’s our turn to fight for her. | | This race is an uphill battle and my daughter did something that took bravery that no one else had. At every turn, I’ve been so proud, knowing how hard it has been, she fought to get to today. This is the Brenda that I’ve known for 45 years, and I’m so happy to see the support she’s gotten and how much good she’s already done with this campaign. This campaign is ALREADY such a success. Now $just imagine how much more good she could do in the Governor’s seat. Let's show up strong for my daughter right now and make sure she knows that we have her back going into election day. Thank you, Hyam Siegel | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2022 Brenda for Vermont. All rights reserved.

Tomorrow may very well prove to be the most pivotal choice our nation has faced in recent political history.

American Freedom VS Far-Left Fraud
STAND FOR FREEDOM (https://secure.winred.com/burnsfornh/tomorrow-is-the-day?utm_source=E-HouseFile&utm_campaign=BurnsB_PG-e-tomorrow-is-the-day-nx8-20221028-a-Deadline_20221103&utm_medium=Email&utm_content=PG-e-tomorrow-is-the-day-nx8-20221028-a-Deadline&utm_agency=PG&utm_source=Burns+for+Congress&utm_campaign=5b060c1ab6-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_11_03_03_57&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_7e3d774d02-5b060c1ab6-252807809)

(https://secure.winred.com/burnsfornh/tomorrow-is-the-day?utm_source=E-HouseFile&utm_campaign=BurnsB_PG-e-tomorrow-is-the-day-nx8-20221028-a-Deadline_20221103&utm_medium=Email&utm_content=PG-e-tomorrow-is-the-day-nx8-20221028-a-Deadline&utm_agency=PG&utm_source=Burns+for+Congress&utm_campaign=5b060c1ab6-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_11_03_03_57&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_7e3d774d02-5b060c1ab6-252807809) so we can Get Out the Vote!

This journey started last year when I announced my campaign for governor. I have spent my life defying the odds: I lost my father to a treatable illness when I was three years old, was raised by a single mother and my grandparents, got into some trouble in my teens, and was ultimately sent to military school.
From there, I joined the U.S. Army and led soldiers in combat in Afghanistan and went on to become a Rhodes Scholar, a small business owner, and the CEO of one of the nation’s largest poverty-fighting organizations.
Now, with your support, I want to continue serving others by becoming the next Governor of Maryland and creating a state that leaves no one behind.
My running mate Aruna and I are committed to fighting for every Marylander by standing up for our democracy and reproductive rights, creating work, wages, and wealth, giving every student a world-class public education, making healthcare more affordable, saving lives by preventing gun violence, taking bold action on climate change, and creating a 21st century public transit system.
Our vision is resonating across the state because we are leading with the values that we embrace as Marylanders — meanwhile, our opponent is an extremist whose views and policy proposals are a danger to Maryland’s families.
_The choice could not be more clear._
**We will win this election because of you all. Because you pushed. Because you believed. And because you always show up.**

clean_body: | = Friends, Tomorrow is the day we’ve been waiting and working so hard for: Election Day. We have come too far to miss our shot at doing something special together. Many Maryland voters have already cast their ballots early or by mail. I was humbled to cast my vote early last week in West Baltimore with my wife Dawn and daughter Mia by my side. What an absolute honor it was to vote for this movement we’ve built together. | = This journey started last year when I announced my campaign for governor. I have spent my life defying the odds: I lost my father to a treatable illness when I was three years old, was raised by a single mother and my grandparents, got into some trouble in my teens, and was ultimately sent to military school. From there, I joined the U.S. Army and led soldiers in combat in Afghanistan and went on to become a Rhodes Scholar, a small business owner, and the CEO of one of the nation’s largest poverty-fighting organizations. Now, with your support, I want to continue serving others by becoming the next Governor of Maryland and creating a state that leaves no one behind. My running mate Aruna and I are committed to fighting for every Marylander by standing up for our democracy and reproductive rights, creating work, wages, and wealth, giving every student a world-class public education, making healthcare more affordable, saving lives by preventing gun violence, taking bold action on climate change, and creating a 21st century public transit system. Our vision is resonating across the state because we are leading with the values that we embrace as Marylanders — meanwhile, our opponent is an extremist whose views and policy proposals are a danger to Maryland’s families. It’s extremely likely that this race will determine control of the Senate.
#
Team,
Before polls open in Wisconsin tomorrow morning, I want to be very clear:
Unlike Ron Johnson, I am not relying on a bunch of billionaire donors and corporate PACs to get us the resources we need to win this election. **The only way we are going to raise what it takes is from lots of people making an immense number of small donations.**
Truly, that is our only path to victory. And we still have some big goals to meet heading into Election Day.
**_Between GOP super PACs and Ron Johnson, Republicans have dumped another $5.7 million into negative media in the last week alone._** We can't let that be the last thing voters see before they go to the polls.
That’s where you come in: we absolutely need to keep pushing until the very end to match Ron Johnson’s dark-money machine and fight off these attack ads before it's too late.
